articleTitle: Research on Diabetes Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Diabetes is a common chronic disease, and accurate prediction of its occurrence is crucial for early diagnosis and prevention of disease progression. To address the problem of difficulty and time-consuming traditional detection methods such as blood and urine tests for early diagnosis of diabetes, this paper models and predicts the Pima Indian diabetes dataset using machine learning algorithms such as KNN, decision tree, and random forest. The performance of the models was evaluated using cross-validation and confusion matrix, and the optimal diabetes prediction model was selected. The results showed that the random forest model performed the best, with an accuracy of 0.84 and an F1 value of 0.77. Compared with traditional diabetes detection methods, the accuracy of diabetes prediction based on machine learning algorithms has been significantly improved. The research results have certain reference value for early diagnosis and prevention of diabetes.

articleTitle: Research on Food Image Recognition of Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, food image recognition has been a research field that has received much attention. Diet is an essential part of people's daily life. Through food image recognition and classification, dietary evaluation is conducted to achieve the goal of healthy eating. Manual features and classification methods in traditional target detection algorithms can no longer meet the requirements of detection accuracy and speed, so it is necessary to introduce depth learning-based techniques into food image recognition. Deep learning is a complex machine learning algorithm that allows computers to simulate the human brain's thinking, judge new problems through data sets (human experience), and improve themselves to obtain relatively accurate models, just like humans. Among them, convolutional neural networks have developed most rapidly. They are applied to image recognition with the expectation of being able to automate recognition through machine learning, thereby reducing the workload of image recognition and providing more objective analysis results. Deep learning has achieved great success in intelligent image processing, image classification, and recognition and has excellent development potential and social value. This article implements automatic recognition of food images based on the recognition algorithm of the YOLOv5 convolutional neural network structure, which can detect food images with high detection efficiency. It explores the combination of deep learning to identify food images, providing a reference for people to eat healthily, especially for obese people to control calorie intake, and providing theoretical support for food image recognition.

articleTitle: Research on real-time dispatch reliability assessment algorithm of smart grid based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The reliability of real-time grid dispatch is crucial for ensuring power supply reliability, energy security and achieving economic efficiency. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a algorithm based on neural networks model for evaluating the reliability of real-time grid dispatch. Firstly, the paper defines three assessment criteria, namely safety margin, over-limit degree and load shedding, and 15 full-scale reliability indicators are constructed with SAE (stacked but automatic coder) features obtained through layer parsing modelling. Secondly, they were substituted into the network layer to train their mapping relationships. The results show that the dispatch time of grid transmission data using this algorithm always does not exceed 9.5 s, realising real-time dispatch of grid transmission data. Compared with traditional dispatch methods, the method proposed in this paper ensures the integrity of the grid transmission data. Moreover, the large number of controllable loads in the selected area can be managed efficiently.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOV5 based industrial surface defect detection method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: in industrial production, defects on the surface of a product can affect the quality and performance of the product, which in turn affects the product’s competitiveness in the market. Therefore, effective surface defect detection is very important to ensure product quality, improve production efficiency and reduce production costs. The use of computer-vision surface defect detection technology in the production process of industrial manufacturing enterprises is able to not only improve product quality and market competitiveness, but also realize production automation and intelligence and promote the development of enterprises towards a more efficient and intelligent direction. In order to improve the small target defect detection capability of the defect detection algorithm model and solve the problem of poor defect location, an improved YOLOV5 algorithm is proposed in this article. The K-Means++ algorithm is used instead of the K-Means algorithm to determine the size of the candidate frame and the ARM, BFF, and ODM modules are added to filter out some samples with small intersection areas of the real candidate frame, and the specific candidate frame size is optimized automatically. Finally, in order to improve the global feature extraction capability and small target detection capability of the algorithm model, the tail of the backbone network in YOLOV5 is changed to the Transformer coder model. The tested average accuracy of the modified algorithm is 70.3%, which is higher than the experimental 65.6% before the modification and achieves good results in defect detection.

articleTitle: Visible Light Intelligent Inspection of Transmission Line UAV Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of The Times, UAV technology is widely used and has been gradually popularized. Now the focus of research is to use UAV in intelligent inspection of transmission lines. However, the accuracy of data obtained by intelligent inspection of UAV is not enough. Machine vision technology is used to improve the accuracy of UAV inspection. Through experiments, this paper tests the quasi swarm rate of UAV inspection before and after using machine vision. The experimental results show that the accuracy of UAV inspection using machine vision is up to 84%, while that of traditional UAV is up to 70%, which proves that machine vision has a good effect on improving the accuracy of UAV inspection.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Early local optima convergence and poor convergence pace in subsequent iterations are issues with the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The probabilistic jumping capability of the simulated annealing algorithm effectively prevents the search from entering local optima. In order to prevent premature convergence to local optima, this work offers an enhanced particle swarm optimization approach that combines a simulated annealing algorithm with probability-based decision-making to manage the particle's direction and velocity in updates. The efficiency of the modified particle swarm optimization approach is assessed using three test functions.

articleTitle: Dynamic capacity increase method of transmission line
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the method of joint dynamic capacity expansion of transmission to address the growing load demand and tight power supply in the power system. This article first briefly introduces the concept and background of dynamic capacity expansion, as well as the limitations and shortcomings of traditional transmission network capacity expansion methods. Subsequently, we proposed a dynamic augmentation method based on real-time data adjustment and optimization, and designed a corresponding dynamic augmentation system. This method is based on algorithm models and techniques, which can accurately detect and evaluate the load demand of the transmission network, and dynamically adjust and optimize the network based on real-time data. Through this method, we can achieve flexible capacity expansion of the transmission network and improve the stability and reliability of the power system. Through this study, our goal is to provide an advanced dynamic capacity augmentation method for the sustainable development of the power system, in order to meet the constantly increasing load demand and ensure the stability and reliability of power supply. Our research provides important reference and guidance for power system planning and operation, and is of great significance for improving the sustainability and economy of the power system.

articleTitle: Lightweight graph convolutional networks combining multimodal fusion and spatio-temporal attention mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Since most mainstream human action recognition methods suffer from high operational complexity and large network parameters, and skeleton behavior recognition is inaccurate for spatio-temporal feature extraction and difficult to capture global contextual information. Firstly, in the data pre-processing stage, three kinds of information data streams related to nodes and skeleton are fused so as to reduce the number of network parameters and improve the operation speed; secondly, the recognition accuracy is improved by constructing a spatio-temporal attention module based on non-local operations to focus on nodes with action discriminative; then a spatio-temporal feature extraction module is constructed to obtain spatio-temporal association information; finally, the Softmax layer is used for action The final action recognition is performed by the Softmax layer. The algorithm achieves accuracies of 89.4% and 95.5% for the two evaluation metrics on the NTU60 RGB+D dataset, and 82.4% and 82.8% on the NTU120 RGB+D dataset. Finally, we did a comparison test with other methods on the dataset UCF101, and the results showed that the recognition speed and accuracy were improved, reflecting the superiority and reliability of the method.

articleTitle: A Used Sailboat Pricing Problem Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Used sailboats change with age and market conditions, and prediction models that extract feature correlations are needed to identify hidden features that affect the listing price of used sailboats and accurately predict the listing price of used sailboats. In this paper, we introduce a graph neural network model and an attention machine mechanism for the problem of predicting the listing price of used sailboats. We collected data on the brand, variety, regional GDP and cargo throughput of sailboats. To abstract information about the dependencies between the two data. On the data side, each sample is used as a node and feature vector (brand, variant, regional GDP, cargo throughput, etc.) to construct the graph data. Treat each sample as a node feature. The similarity between two graph nodes is calculated using Pearson similarity algorithm and used as initialized edge weights. On this model, a graph convolutional neural network (GCN) is constructed with an MSE loss function and the final loss is obtained after bringing the data into the model for training. The attention mechanism is then introduced and the attention weight matrix is output to obtain the weights of the sailboat feature vector, where the average cargo throughput (tons) has the greatest effect on the listed price of the sailboat used.

articleTitle: Research on the Operational Safety Evaluation of a Type of Aircraft Based on Entropy Value Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to study the safety condition of aviation operation, the entropy value method is applied to evaluate the safety operation of an aircraft type. Based on the event type, number of events, event level and flight time, a risk-value safety evaluation index system was established, and the safety situation in the past years was calculated by the entropy method. The results show that the evaluation results are basically consistent with the actual operation of a certain type of aircraft, indicating that the safety evaluation method based on the entropy value method is applicable to aviation operation safety evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of E-Commerce Service System Based on Computer 3D Image Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper builds an e-commerce operation service system which includes interface layer, core function layer, business process layer, service layer and resource layer Based on computer 3D image vision technology based on computer 3D image vision technology. Then the paper proposes a simplified 2D human hand model, which models the human hand as a palm point and 5 fingers, and design a human hand tracking method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. The system uses Web server selection algorithm (RFWS) based on optimal request forwarding. A load balancing solution of e-business service system based on RFWS is constructed. The experimental simulation shows that the scheme is feasible and effective, and can greatly improve the access efficiency of users.

articleTitle: Research on multi-model ensemble machine learning methods for temperature forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of short-term and imminent surface air temperature forecast in Beijing, a multi-model ensemble rolling temperature forecasting model was developed using two machine learning methods: ridge regression and support vector machines. The model was based on 2 m temperature numerical forecast products from four weather forecast models with 24-hour lead times from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (EC), the US National Centers for Environmental Prediction in the United States (GFS), the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), and the Beijing Meteorological Bureau Rapid-refresh Multi-scale Analysis and Prediction System (RMAPS), as well as observations from 20 national-level stations in Beijing. The results showed that the machine learning-based multi-model ensemble effectively corrected the systematic bias in the model forecasts. The absolute mean bias of temperature forecasts was less than 0.3 °C for the 20 stations, and the root mean square error of the forecasts was smaller than that of any individual model and its equally weighted ensemble mean. The accuracy of the forecasts was significantly improved. Compared to the equal-weight ensemble mean results, the multi-model ensemble method based on ridge regression and support vector machines significantly improved the skill of temperature forecasts in the mountainous areas of Beijing. During the operation period, the forecast accuracy of temperature in FoYeDing is improved by over 30%, which has better operational application value.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Aided Measurement System in Orthodontics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: MSSQL Server database technology is used to save and manage tooth model image data. This paper introduces a computer technology of orthodontic diagnosis and treatment information processing system. The system is a comprehensive diagnostic management system which integrates clinical data record, model, diagnosis analysis and reference treatment plan, patient online inquiry and other functions. This method can effectively improve the parameter determination and analysis of the system. It can improve the level of parameter measurement and analysis and reduce the measurement error of orthodontic model.

articleTitle: Understanding Ceramic Pattern Drawing System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Color Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper introduces the method of computer aided interactive pattern design and pattern editing. A pattern mapping method based on the parameters related to surface arc length is among of the issue and needs a new propose system. The objective of this paper is to understand the CAD system for color matching pattern. In the methodology part of the studies, a realization method of CAD system for color matching pattern is designed by using object-oriented and visual programming. The system uses the pull-down menu technology and the screen graphic visualization to make the ceramic pattern easily and quickly. This reduces the repetitive work of the designer in painting the ceramic. The result based on experimental simulation shows that the ceramic pattern drawing is reasonable and the graphic performance is realistic.

articleTitle: Path planning and image classification algorithms for glass cleaning robots based on hybrid path planning and convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of the times and the progress of society, the number of high-rise buildings is increasing, and the cleaning of the outer glass at height is extremely difficult, relying on manual cleaning with high safety risks and low efficiency. The trend is to use automated control products such as cleaning robots to take on some of the difficult cleaning work. Path planning and image recognition for glass cleaning robots is a hot issue for cleaning robots to achieve efficient cleaning. In this paper, a path planning and image recognition method for glass cleaning robots based on hybrid path planning and convolutional neural networks is proposed to address this hot problem. The cleaning robot adopts a hybrid path of contour-parallel path and method-parallel path to achieve full-coverage path planning, and uses a portable camera to take photos of the glass, and uses a convolutional neural network model to determine the degree of dirty glass, and uses this as the basis for different cleaning processes, effectively improving the efficiency of cleaning and the utilisation of resources. In this paper, we design an intelligent control algorithm for a glass cleaning robot that combines artificial intelligence and 3D printing path planning generation by combining two of these methods, which helps to improve the cleaning effect of the cleaning robot.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Diesel Engine Rail Pressure Adaptive Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Taking a high pressure common rail diesel engine as the research object. Measure and obtain the working rail pressure value of the diesel engine. After filtering, use it as the feedback value of the closed-loop control of rail pressure, and calculate the target value of the control of derailing pressure. Establish the rail pressure adaptive PID controller, which mainly includes rail pressure setting value calculation, rail pressure feedforward control, rail pressure controller parameter calculation, actuator output control and so on. Through the closed-loop control test of high pressure common rail fuel system, the effect of adaptive PID control of high pressure common rail is analyzed, and the key factors affecting the rail pressure control system are obtained, in order to provide reference for the development of high pressure common rail diesel engine controller.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Processing System Based on AI and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article studies an infrared image processing method and infrared system, which includes: obtaining the infrared signal collected by the infrared optical lens, and converting the infrared signal into the original infrared image; Preprocess the original infrared image to obtain the preprocessed infrared image; Using an image enhancement model to enhance the pre processed infrared image, the enhanced infrared image is obtained; Among them, the image enhancement model uses pre processed sample infrared images and enhanced sample infrared images to train the first convolutional neural network. The technical solution studied in this article uses an image enhancement model trained on convolutional neural networks to process infrared images, in order to reduce the complexity of image processing and improve image processing efficiency and quality. Moreover, the image enhancement model has extremely high upgrade flexibility and is relatively simple to implement. Therefore, it can efficiently and conveniently achieve flexible upgrades in processing.

articleTitle: Design of "Data Structure" Resource Platform for Computer Major Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Resource management based on cloud computing is essentially to deliver resource services to corresponding user terminals through virtualization processing of scattered resources in the network space through the "lease" mode. In order to meet the needs of the "online+offline" hybrid teaching mode reform, this paper studies the cloud computing resource scheduling model based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. The architecture model is composed of user access layer, application service layer, platform service layer and resource pool layer. The organizational resources are composed of "Data Structure" resources of the computer specialty. This platform has the characteristics of software architecture unification, function modularization, service standardization and personalization, effectively integrates the high-quality teaching resources of "Data Structure" for computer specialty, and realizes the unified planning, deployment and management of teaching resources.

articleTitle: A Study of Wordle Dataset Based on the World-Heat and ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the changes in Wordle dataset over a specific period of time, explains and predicts this change, and divides the problem into three steps for better research. First, establishment of the Wordle-Heat Model of furnace temperature curve explains the change in the number of reported results. After solving, the change was divided into five stages, stable period, recession period, mature region, entrepreneurial period and long-term period. Then explained and analyzed each stage. After that, the Wordle Data Prediction Model based on ARIMA time series algorithm was established to predict the number range of results on specific dates. The report interval for March 1, 2023 was obtained by solving the model, [9868, 14118]. Finally, based on the multiple regression analysis algorithm, this paper analyzed the correlation between some attributes of the word and the reported score percentage in the Hard Mode, and calculated the influence between the two, and conducted specific analysis through the outliers.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Image Cryptosystem Based on Computer Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: According to the order interest of gray code and machine vision binary key, a complete digital image cryptographic algorithm is presented. A new method based on wavelet transform is proposed. At the same time, gray code watch has a strong ability of time and space traversal and a strong generative ability. The experiment proves that compared with the existing cryptographic system, the cryptographic algorithm described in this paper completely scrambles and diffuses the original image. It has 3.08x105000 keywords. Secure image encryption system can resist violent network attacks. Compared with the existing papers on computer vision encryption, the experimental results are optimistic. The running time during the scrambling and diffusion phases is very smooth.

articleTitle: Using Frequency Domain Dielectric Spectrum for Aging State Evaluation of Transformer Oil Paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To better implement the frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy technology to the nondestructive diagnosis of the aging state of transformer oil paper insulation, a new aging state evaluation method for transformer oil paper is proposed by integrating FDS and branch wavelet analysis. Firstly, the relative dielectric constant and dielectric loss factor of transformer oil paper insulation samples with different aging degrees are investigated by frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy. Combined with wavelet analysis theory, an improved algorithm for time-domain dielectric spectrum is put forward, and the characteristic quantities representing the aging time of each part of oil paper are extracted. Finally, the effects of different insulation aging and moisture on the frequency domain dielectric spectrum and frequency domain dielectric loss integral spectrum and their variation rules are analyzed and summarized. The test conditions in this paper is proved to solve the influence of different test temperatures on FDS results, and it can quantitatively reflect the change of aging degree of oil paper insulation.

articleTitle: Multi-label Classification of Road Cracks Based on Semantic-Aware Mixup
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the realm of road crack detection scenarios, Mixup, a widely used data augmentation technique, exhibits constrained effectiveness in multi-label classification, unlike its performance on general datasets. This paper investigates the reasons behind this limitation, identifying two main factors: (1) the mutually exclusive nature of road crack labels and (2) the potential generation of incorrect labels during image mixing. To address these issues, we propose an approach called Semantic-Aware Mixup (SA-Mixup), which focuses on enhancing crack samples specifically. Experimental evaluations on three distinct road crack datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and simplicity of our proposed method. The results highlight significant improvements in model performance, offering a promising solution for accurate and efficient multi-label classification in road crack detection tasks.

articleTitle: Wordle result prediction based on machine learning algorithm LSTM model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Wordle, a novel word puzzle courtesy of the New York Times, is becoming popular on the Internet. Since players are willing to share their scores on Twitter, this adds a social attribute to the game. We first conducted a multi-factor ANOVA on the attributes of the words and the percentage of scores in the difficult mode. The results showed that the letters in the first four positions of the word and the number of repeated letters in the word had an effect on the percentage of scores. Next, we proposed a multiple-input-multiple-output long and short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the distribution of reported outcomes. To incorporate the internal effects of the data into the study, we designed a six-input-seven-output LSTM regression prediction model and trained it with the dataset. Then, the trained network was used to predict the distribution of "EERIE" scores. To predict the difficulty of words, a random forest model was designed to determine which of these attributes were associated with each classification by using several attributes carefully selected from the words. Finally, the difficulty of the word "EERIE" was predicted.

articleTitle: A somatic game-based rehabilitation training system for mild cognitive impairment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In response to the problems that current products for mild cognitive impairment lack sensory stimulation for patients and are not designed for the characteristics of the elderly group with mild cognitive impairment, and cannot effectively improve cognitive functions, this paper integrates cognitive science, rehabilitation medicine, and game design to carry out research and design a set of gamepad-based somatosensory interaction device, including the construction of hardware system and the development of software system. The system can train patients' memory, calculation, logical reasoning, and spatial orientation, thus improving their cognitive status and slowing down the progression of dementia. The research content of this paper provides a new non-pharmacological intervention method for patients with mild cognitive impairment.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Big Data in Satellite Orbit Multiple Positioning Measurement and Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A method to extract satellite orbit parameters by combining GPS observation data and radar observation data was proposed. The research results of this project can be applied to the fusion and analysis of the pseudo distance and change rate of GPS observed values and the range and change rate of radar observed values. Experiments show that the proposed method has strong anti-interference ability, and the Kalman filter method is used to predict it effectively. The feasibility of this algorithm is verified by comparison with common radar observation data.

articleTitle: Human motion trajectory generation based on AWR1642
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, we study the human motion trajectory generation in single and multi-person motion scenarios. Firstly, the data are collected by AWR1642 millimeter wave radar, and the signal distribution map in space is generated by beam forming algorithm, and the human motion trajectory is finally generated by locating the location of energy maxima in different moments and converging the maxima under different frames. In order to eliminate the interference of static multi path in the environment to the experimental data, the accuracy of the generated trajectories is improved by differential processing of the data. This paper also extends the experimental scope to multi-person motion scenes, and for the part of targets that cannot be localized due to different distances of multiple targets from the transmitting and receiving antenna positions, this paper proposes a mask-by-mask approach, i.e., first locating the human trajectory at the strongest target, then setting the mask to zero within a certain range of the target trajectory area, and then locating the next slightly weaker signal human trajectory, and so on alliterative until the trajectories of all people are successfully generated.This paper experimentally verifies the accuracy and stability of the human trajectory generation technique.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Objective Questions Generating Examination Paper System Based on Random Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer networks and artificial intelligence, the examination method has changed from traditional paper to computer-aided. The essence of the intelligent test paper generation problem is a multi-objective parameter optimization problem that satisfies some constraints. The purpose of the design of the intelligent test paper generation algorithm is to select some test questions based on the test question bank, and to require the properties of the test questions to meet the needs of test paper design. In this paper, by comparing the commonly used intelligent test paper generation algorithms, random extraction algorithm is finally selected. The random selection method uses fixed test paper standards or constraints, randomly selects test questions from the test question bank, and follows certain rules to arrange and combine them into the final test paper. This paper studies the constraints and basic process of test paper generation based on random extraction algorithm in detail, and provides support for the design of the generating examination paper system for objective test of Chinese as a foreign language.

articleTitle: Simulation Model and Data Acquisition Method for Wind Turbine Group
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article presents a novel approach to simulating and collecting data for a direct-drive wind turbine array. The simulation model for the direct-drive wind turbine array encompasses various components, including the direct-drive fan, a multiplier amplifier, a controlled current source, the line's equivalent impedance, and the power grid. The direct-drive fan is linked to the controlled current source and the line's equivalent impedance, serving to transmit the fan's current signal to the equivalent impedance of the line. Meanwhile, the multiplier amplifier connects to a controlled current source, tasked with multiplying and amplifying the external system's fan current signal based on the predefined number of fans. Subsequently, it transmits the multiplied and amplified fan current signal back to the controlled current source. The controlled current source then utilizes this amplified fan current signal as a reference value to deliver its controlled current source signal to the equivalent impedance of the line. Ultimately, both the controlled current source signal and the fan current signal are channeled into the power grid through the line's equivalent impedance. This innovative approach is highly applicable to conducting system simulation analyses for large-scale wind power integration, resulting in a significant reduction in computational workload and a substantial increase in practical engineering value.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Intelligent 3D Aided Technology in Design Modeling System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper presents the architecture of computer aided industrial design based on application Service provider pattern. The system designed and developed in this paper consists of four toolsets, each of which is developed using reusable component technology and dynamically loaded into the computer aided industrial design platform. Process model and process diagram of parts were generated by reverse reconstruction method. The process model and 2D process diagram of shaft sleeve parts in reverse order are generated automatically. The key technologies in toolset development, such as style and shape layout template, color scheme library, man-machine operation component library and appearance evaluation, are studied. The experimental simulation shows that the system can improve the design ability of enterprises and is an important part of regional networked manufacturing.

articleTitle: Implementing a Wide Frequency Range Tightly Coupled Wireless Charging System Using Hybrid Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In response to the issue of coupling coefficient and frequency variation leading to system output power fluctuations in wireless power transmission systems, this paper proposes a tightly coupled wireless charging system with a wide frequency range based on hybrid topology. Firstly, output characteristics of SS and LCC-LCC topology circuits are analyzed in this paper, then a hybrid topology structure with a DDQ coil structure is proposed. Secondary, a parameter optimization method is proposed to optimize the parameters of the compensation network. Finally, build the system circuit in MATLAB simulation software to verify the feasibility of theoretical analysis. The simulation results show that when the system frequency changes between 78kHz and 96kHz, the output power of the system remains approximately 11kW, and when the coupling coefficient changes, the output power of the system can also maintain stationarity.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Based Simulation of Key Technology of Coal Mine Power Supply Teaching Experiment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Coal mine power supply technology is the core course of electrical engineering in mining colleges and universities. Due to the complexity and particularity of power supply environment, it is hard to put into practice in teaching. So that to boost students' experimental level and engineering design ability, a virtual simulation system of coal mine power supply is built on account of virtual reality technology. The system introduces Quadric Error Metrics algorithm for model simplification, and an improved folding cost is adopted to keep the details of the model. The system simulates the key technology of coal mine power supply teaching experiment, and realizes the functions of theory learning, scene roaming, equipment maintenance, knowledge examination and so on. The experiment can motivate students' hobby in studing, enrich the teaching experiment course, and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Dong Embroidery APP Mini Program
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper discusses the user experience and interaction mode of Dong embroidery application program from the perspective of user experience theory. An adaptive needling algorithm is designed by using GDI+ function library, thinning algorithm and link coding algorithm. This algorithm can realize the reasonable layout of any font. The fuzzy control method combined with microprocessor technology is adopted to achieve accurate and rapid positioning and stop control of the high-speed rotating machine tool spindle. The practical application results show that the system can make the designed computer embroidery machine stop within the specified Angle ±1° within three weeks.

articleTitle: Research on embedded digital communication processing system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This project mainly studies the hardware architecture of the system, digital signal encoding and decoding processing and digital communication protocol. The composition of hardware architecture needs to address the adaptation of communication rate and information acquisition part to achieve the optimal hardware state, timely collect digital signals for processing and make system-level response; Digital signal encoding and decoding is the key to data signal processing and transmission of the project. Noise reduction and compression are completed by corresponding algorithms, and then transmitted to other equipment terminals via digital links for decompression and processing; The digital communication system adopts the serial communication network, and the communication mode adopts the single master/multiple slave device mode to realize the single master/multiple slave two-way communication and realize the communication control of the distributed electronic system.

articleTitle: Research on Factor Importance Feature Recognition Algorithm Based on KPCA-GBDT-LightGBM Intelligent Coupling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to effectively identify factors and analyze the importance of factors, this paper proposes a feature recognition importance algorithm. Firstly, this paper uses the factor dimension reduction algorithm based on kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) to optimize the variable dimension to avoid dimension disaster. On this basis, the Gradient Boosting Decision Tree algorithm is used for ensemble learning to form the LightGBM algorithm for importance factor identification. Finally, 1975 sets of data are verified by the algorithm. The mean square error (MSE) and the coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) index system are used as test indicators to ensure the correctness and accuracy of the algorithm. The results show that: (1) The KPCA dimension reduction method can improve the analysis efficiency, and the research accuracy is better than that of the previous model (2) The algorithm is robust and can identify and predict the importance factor at the same time.

articleTitle: Application of improved LSTM model and visualization analysis in bike-sharing demand prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Nowadays, accurately analyzing and predicting the demand for shared bicycles to rationalize their dispatching strategies is a question worth exploring. A visualization method is used to analyze the characteristics of the number for shared bicycles around this problem. Considering that the data presents nonlinear long time series and seasonal characteristics, the LSTM model is used for processing, which has forgetting and memory functions and can handle long time series data by the gating mechanism. After dimensionality reduction by Spearman correlation analysis, an LSTM model that performs well in handling long-time series data is constructed for prediction. The experimental results illustrate that compared with a single model, the LSTM model in this study generally improves by about 20% in accuracy, providing a constructive basis for bike-sharing demand prediction, optimizing the scheduling and allocation of bike-sharing, and improving the efficiency of this travel system.

articleTitle: Research on Self-powering Technology of Foreign Object Detection Circuit in Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: For electric vehicles wireless power transfer (EV-WPT), the existing foreign object detection (FOD) solutions all use a switch mode power supply to power the FOD signal board. However, the transmit coil itself generates a magnetic field, which also has energy. Using this energy to replace the Switch Mode Power Supply can simplify the system structure, reduce energy waste, and integrate the signal board with the transmitting coil module to avoid significant interference caused by long communication lines. This article proposes a scheme to modify the structure of the transmitting coil, so that the externally assisted self-powering coil can utilize the energy of the transmitting coil while reducing interference with the foreign object detection coil array and receiving coil, achieving non-interference self-powering supply to the detection circuit.

articleTitle: Intelligent Construction of E-commerce Product Traceability System Based on Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of network technology and information technology, the Internet has inexorably entered people's life, and changed people's way of life. However, due to the virtual and trans-regional nature of e-commerce, the products purchased by consumers may have quality risks. As an effective supervisory tool, traceability is an effective measure to ensure the quality of e-commerce products. At present, the development of traceability in foreign countries is relatively mature, and specific industries such as food and agricultural products are also widely applied in China. However, at home and abroad, the application of traceability in e-commerce is still relatively small. Therefore, in view of this problem, this paper aims to explore the correlation between e-commerce product data through correlation analysis, from the based on the correlation analysis and trend prediction of the base data, the potential rules and patterns are found through analysis, and finally the network model is constructed to meet the actual needs of risk management, and the traceability efficiency evaluation and traceability algorithm design are realized. The experiment proves that the improved Bayesian algorithm is superior to the NB algorithm. After feature selection and dimension reduction, the model training of the improved Bayesian algorithm is carried out, and its accuracy reaches the highest at 18,500 dimensions. Applying the improved weighted Bayes algorithm to the quality risk control assessment of e-commerce goods can better predict the quality risk level of e-commerce goods.

articleTitle: Computer Cloud Computing Technology in the Capture of Colour Information in Visual Communication Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the design and analysis capabilities of industrial product packaging colours while constructing an industrial product packaging colour bionic feature extraction system under visual communication, the paper proposes a kind of industrial product packaging colour bionics under visual communication based on block feature matching and edge contour detection. Feature extraction algorithm. The article adopts the block feature matching method to realize the visual enhancement processing of the colour bionic image of industrial product packaging. The article extracts the block feature quantity of the colour bionic feature of industrial product packaging. The article uses the sparse representation method of image blocks to realize the extraction of colour bionic features of industrial product packaging. In addition, the designed human-computer interaction system satisfies people's usage habits. The EC5-1719CLDNA embedded star is used as a hardware platform, combined with a mini-projection system and a radiation control system, and a paperless office interaction engine is developed in the software to make full use of Powerful computing performance of threads and hardware platform. Finally, the system is tested, and the results show that the system can meet actual needs.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Big Data and Internet of Things Technology in International Logistics Intelligent Freight System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper uses computer big data and Internet of Things technology to simulate and model logistics activities of international freight center. Firstly, this paper gives the structure of the model, the definition of main functional modules and the confirmation process of the model. Then, considering the timeliness of logistics distribution and logistics distribution cost comprehensively, an international material distribution optimization model is constructed with the optimization objective of delivering goods to the place specified by customers within the expected shipping time with the minimum freight cost. Using ASP.NET development environment to realize the logistics transportation intelligent stowing system simulation part of the logistics company freight data test. The test results show that the intelligent stowing method is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Planning Algorithms Based on Machine Learning Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper solve the optimal cost problem of production planning model, construct a model based on linear programming and multi-objective planning, target the optimal cost in a one-week inspection interval, implement interactive linear and generic optimization solutions with the help of Lingo, determine the objective function as the total cost, construct the cost function, and establish the constraint function relationship in conjunction with reality. Firstly, it is concluded that the production preparation cost is lower than the relative inventory cost for WPCR and all (sub)components, and replacing the production preparation cost with the inventory cost is not an optimal solution. Then, based on the multi-objective planning model, the model is further optimized on the basis of dynamic planning to build an integer planning model. The results show that after further optimization of the model, the total cost is reduced by 16.06% based on the dynamic planning model. In this paper, a new hair production combination algorithm is developed, which can provide a methodology for later production optimization.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Optimal LSTM Combinatorial Model Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of wind power bring challenges to the accurate prediction of wind power. In this paper, a unique method is introduced that merges a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) to develop a combined model called CNN-LSTM. The effectiveness of this model was assessed using several measures, such as mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), and coefficient of determination (R2) on a training dataset (80% of the data) and a testing dataset (20% of the data). Moreover, the performance of the CNN-LSTM model was juxtaposed with the BP neural network model and the LSTM neural network model. The results show that the four performance indexes of CNN-LSTM model are better than the other two neural network models, which can effectively reduce the prediction error and have superior prediction performance.

articleTitle: Medium-voltage Distribution Network Planning Based on Genetic Tabu Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: to find the best medium-voltage distribution network planning and prevent the transmission line crossover, this paper proposes an improved genetic Tabu hybrid algorithm (GTHA) which combines the advantages of genetic algorithm (GA) and Tabu search algorithm (TS). The improved algorithm can prevent the premature convergence problem of GA and realize the transformation from the local optimal solution to the global optimal solution. At the same time, the GTHA adds the restrict of transmission line crossover into the network topology constraint. Therefore, it cannot only carry out the optimal planning of distribution network but also prevents the transmission line crossover. The GTHA has been successfully applied to IEEE 69-bus and 136-bus systems, and the results demonstrate the feasibility of this algorithm. This study can provide a reference value for the wiring group layout of a medium-voltage distribution network.

articleTitle: Design of RFID access control system based on 51 microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness of access control system in terms of safety, security and management convenience, this paper designs an RFID access control system based on 51 microcontroller. The access control system in this paper uses the RC522 and S50 keycard as the core technology, combined with a rectangular keypad and fingerprint recognition system to achieve safe and reliable access control. By using the 51 microcontroller as a bridge to connect the input and output modules, it realizes the collaborative work between the modules to process and transmit the relevant data. The output adopts sound and light alarm module, LCD display and relay driver module to realize real-time monitoring and warning function. The system design not only has high efficiency, stability and strong security, but also has the flexibility of scalability and reliability, compared with the traditional access control system, more secure and convenient.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of credit score card for solving the QUBO model based on annealing algorithm and quantum computer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The optimization algorithm of the quantum computer can better find the correlation between the different factors in the credit score card, so as to better predict the credit risk. By establishing a multivariate nonlinear integer programming model and transforming it into a QUBO model [1], the bank credit score card is combined optimized to maximize the total bank revenue. First, we establish a multivariate nonlinear integer programming model to convert the quadratic Hamiltonian operator into the form of multiple matrix products. We use the quantum annealing algorithm to find a credit score card in 100 credit score cards and find the corresponding threshold to maximize the total revenue target function. Secondly, on the basis of the above model, we choose the designated three credit score cards and only select one set of thresholds for each credit score card, and find the threshold values corresponding to the three credit score cards, so that the total income target function is the largest. Finally, we arbitrarily selected three credit score cards and only each credit score card chooses one set of threshold, and found the threshold corresponding to the three credit score cards, so that the total income target function is the largest. The above are converted to QUBO form solution [2].

articleTitle: Improved PS-InSAR Technology for Disaster Investigation and Monitoring of a Transmission Line Corridor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The surface deformation monitoring of transmission lines is an important part of power grid security monitoring. In this paper, a large-scale deformation monitoring study is conducted on large-scale and long-distance transmission lines. The traditional PS-InSAR method is prone to fewer reference points, error transmission, data processing and storage. This paper presents an improved PS-InSAR method for surface deformation monitoring of transmission lines. The traditional approach suffers from issues such as limited reference points, error propagation, data processing, and storage. In this paper, we propose an improved PS-InSAR approach for large-scale and high-precision surface deformation monitoring in the transmission corridors. The proposed method utilizes block processing and hierarchical network construction to achieve accurate and comprehensive solutions. Additionally, 78 Sentinel-1 radar images were processed to monitor surface hazards along an UHV transmission line in Yunnan Province, China. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in disaster monitoring.

articleTitle: Submarine induced magnetic field simulation method based on multi-magnet combination
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The magnetic field signal induced by the submarine will be captured and located by the airborne magnetic probe. In order to improve the survival rate of submarine after being located, a decoy based on the combination of multiple magnets was designed. The decoy is composed of several solenoid coils, which are arranged linearly among different solenoid coils. The rotation Angle, equivalent current and distance between magnets of each solenoid coil are optimized by genetic algorithm. The simulation results show that the degree of fitting between the decoy and the vertical component of the magnetic field of the submarine at a height of 15m reaches 71.6%, and the total length of the control decoy is less than 7m, which has a certain engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Research of SMT Mounter Z-axis Integral Terminal Sliding Mode Tracking Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The mounting head of the SMT mounter is the most core part of the entire SMT mounter, and the change in load at the end of the Z-axis of the mounting head affects the work efficiency of the entire machine. In this paper, the mathematical model of Z-axis drive system is established firstly. Secondly, a new type of integral terminal sliding mode surface was designed, and the approximation characteristics of neural networks were utilized to approximate modeling errors and external disturbances, avoiding chattering in controller. The stability of the system was demonstrated through Lyapunov theorem. Finally, the validity of the proposed measures was verified through simul-ation analysis, enabling the Z-axis of the mounting head to accurately reach the required position throughout the entire control phase.

articleTitle: Research on Internet Public Opinion Analysis Technology in the New Media Era Based on Hadoop Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Hadoop is an open-source distributed infrastructure developed based on Java. As one of the most popular technologies in the background of cloud computing and big data era, it solves the key problems of big data parallel computing, storage and management, and presents high security, stability, efficiency, scalability and low cost. In the new media era, information communication presents the characteristics of multiple communication subjects, diverse carriers, timeliness, openness and interactivity, which lead to the transfer of traditional media audience to new media. Based on Hadoop platform, this paper carries out research on Internet public opinion analysis technology in the new media era, constructs a mathematical model for Internet public opinion analysis, designs Internet public opinion analysis and its implementation methods in the new media era, which is of great significance for improving the governance level of Internet public opinion in the new media era.

articleTitle: Research on Root Canal Therapy System Based on Computer and 3D Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: the digital root canal model of tooth morphology was established by 3D scanning and printing technology. The layered expression grid box is constructed, and the automatic sorting of grid box is completed. This method is combined with feature extraction method to complete the general modeling analysis. A preliminary dental root canal diagnosis report was made with reference to the standard values in the standard joint venture database. The application of this system will be helpful to the clinical diagnosis and treatment of root canal therapy.

articleTitle: The Study of Ideological and Political Distance Class Based on Computer Internet Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper takes smart phone as the core to develop the ideological and political education network of college students. This software uses C/S as the software development framework. The use of Android system client and server to achieve college students psychological counseling and communication. Based on implicit Markov theory, this paper presents a method of speech recognition for instructional video. The purpose is to complete the text extraction of voice/video. The system adopts the way of speech recognition. Translate the teacher's lecture into words. Keywords are extracted by automatic summarization technology. Through the simulation and analysis of network environment, it is concluded that the network teaching system of distance education based on network has good effect. All work can be normal and fast response.

articleTitle: Classification of Violations in the Examination Room Based on Deep Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the field of proctoring, cameras play an irreplaceable role, but the traditional invigilation methods for monitoring students during exams require a large number of invigilators, which can be a waste of manpower, resources, and finances. In recent years, the rapid development of deep learning technology has shown potential for recognizing abnormal behavior in various settings, including examination rooms. Test postural assistant detection algorithm in the examination room studied in this paper aims to use computer technology instead of human power to automatically detect behaviors in surveillance video. In this paper, five algorithms are used to identify any violations of test discipline in the examination room and compare the recognition results. The experimental results show that DenseNet can effectively detect video frames containing violations in the video sequence, and the average detection accuracy is 95.62%, which can accurately identify these behaviors such as looking left and right in the examination room and passing items. The study also presents a self-built database to support model training and testing. The experiments were conducted on self-built dataset of examination room videos. The findings of this study have important implications for improving examination security and reducing the need for large numbers of invigilators.

articleTitle: An optimized neural network approach and its application to classification problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Traditional neural network models are plagued with slow training speed and low classification accuracy, posing numerous challenges to the development of image classification technology. To address these issues, this paper employs a multi-strategy integrated optimization framework to optimize the training speed and classification accuracy of the model on the basis of the Resnet-18 network model. Firstly, the center loss function is introduced to optimize the softmax loss function, thereby improving the classification accuracy. Secondly, the original SGD optimizer is replaced with the Adam optimizer to address the slow training speed of the Resnet-18 network model. A garbage dataset is utilized to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm. The results demonstrate that after 40 rounds of training, the classification accuracy of the model optimized by multiple strategies increased from 81.42% to 87.42%. The neural network model optimized by multiple strategies can effectively identify classification problems, thereby enhancing the accuracy and stability of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Forecasting Method of Power Grid Communication Service Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Continuous and stable power supply of the distribution network is very important for power transmission, and accurately predicting the amount of business needs in the process of grid communication is the key to the continuous and stable operation of the distribution network. The traditional method for predicting the demand for power grid communication services has significant errors and cannot meet the design requirements of existing power grid communication solutions. There is an urgent need for an accurate and fast method for predicting the demand for power grid communication services. Therefore, this article designs a power grid communication service prediction method based on intelligent algorithms. This method combines the advantages of BP neural network, analyzes the key factors of power grid communication business demand, identifies and processes abnormal data of power grid communication business, and constructs a power grid communication business demand prediction model based on BP neural network. The simulation test results show that the intelligent algorithm based on power grid communication business prediction method designed in this article is more accurate in prediction, with better fitting of prediction indicators and standard indicators. The prediction effect is better than traditional methods. This method can effectively predict the demand for power grid communication services and has certain application value.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Data Trend with the Combination of ARIMA and Dynamic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article combines ARIMA with Dynamic System model to propose a novel method for predicting data trends. The prediction of data trends is often divided into qualitative and quantitative forecasting. Qualitative forecasting relies on the expertise and analytical judgment of professionals, as well as the objective attributes of the phenomenon itself. Quantitative forecasting involves mathematically describing the regularities of phenomena and predicting their development trends. Both qualitative and quantitative forecasting have their advantages and disadvantages. In this study, Dynamic System and ARIMA models are used to represent the qualitative and quantitative research approaches, respectively. The study explores the strengths and weaknesses of these two models in predicting continuous data with peaks, and attempts to integrate them. It is found that the former can better predict macro-level overall trends and peaks, while the latter allows for micro-level, precise predictions.

articleTitle: Research on Wordle based on time series ARIMA model and XGBoost model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Wordle is a word-guessing game that has gained popularity online. Players have to guess a five-letter word by receiving feedback in the form of colored tiles. This paper uses ARIMA and XGBoost models to solve the prediction problem covered in Wordle. The mod-el ARIMA is used to predict the number of reported results on March 1, 2023, and the predicted interval is [18986 to 21753]. After obtaining the prediction results, the paper found that the P-value of Q-statistic is 0.276 in the process of testing the model, which indicates that the prediction model is reasonable. XGBoost model in machine learning is used to predict the distribution of the reported results. Firstly, this paper conducts data processing and divide the data set into training set and a test set in a ratio of 4:1. After determining the parameters of the XGBoost Model, the paper uses the test set for Supervised Learning, obtaining the prediction results of the distribution. The values of MSE, MAE and RMSE are all between 0 and 0.1, and it is concluded that its prediction ability is strong. In addition, the paper evaluates the sensitivity of each model, perturbs the relevant parameters in the range of 5%, and find that the dependent variable changed significantly, which means good sensitivity of the model.

articleTitle: Transformer Oil Micro Water Content Online Monitoring Module Design Based on Linux Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of on-line monitoring of micro water in transformer oil, a structured and modular scheme is proposed for system software design. ARM9 embedded microprocessor is adopted in the hardware to realize the online data acquisition and processing of micro water information, through the conversion of the sensor output signal. Then the software monitoring process of Linux platform is designed, and the directory structure of embedded operating system, porting target platform and Linux kernel source code is provided. The experiment on the test transformer shows that the sensor works normally and it can be comprehensively implemented to solve the problem of online monitoring of micro water content in transformer oil.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Automatic Building Model Based on Computer BIM System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This topic based on BIM model, Vue framework, B/S architecture will be distributed underground water source heat pump, lighting control, fresh air, envelope structure, video monitoring and other intelligent subsystems integrated into a unified platform. In this way, integrated management is realized. The system has achieved the goals of centralized management, systematic operation and maintenance, digitized information and three-dimensional visualization. This paper introduces a way to transform the basic category mode of construction industry into the expanded mode of Chengdu topographic map. In the whole building level from the information integration, visualization, positioning automation three aspects of comprehensive improvement. By conducting field visits to the operation manager and testing the prototype system, the reasons for the failure of the air conditioning system can be found more deeply.

articleTitle: Classification and prediction of ECG data based on decision trees and their optimization algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The heart beat is usually synchronized with the electrical activity of the heart, and the ECG records the representation of the heart's electrical signals on the body surface. In this study, we developed a classification algorithm model for cardiac arrhythmias by analyzing ECG data. We first constructed a classification model to determine the danger level of ECG data using a decision tree approach to achieve real-time judgment and alarm of arrhythmias. The model was then post-pruned and optimized to further classify and predict specific categories for each risk level in conjunction with the actual situation, resulting in an algorithmic model with relatively high prediction accuracy. This will provide an important monitoring tool for cardiac patients and promote timely treatment.

articleTitle: Simulation of Sound Field Distribution in Rotary Condenser Room Based on COMSOL
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of DC transmission technology, the problem of excessive noise of substation boundary caused by the noise of converter station rotary condenser room often occurs. There are few studies on the sound source characteristics and sound field distribution of the rotary condenser, and its noise influence cannot be ignored. In this paper, based on comsol, a scaled simulation model of the rotary condenser room is established. The noise distribution inside and outside the room of the rotary condenser room is calculated, and compared with the measured value, the noise distribution inside and outside the converter station is obtained. The research conclusion can guide the project planning to predict the noise distribution more accurately and avoid the problem of excessive noise after completion

articleTitle: Road Pothole Detection Based on AlexNet for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the frequent use of cars, it has been an increase in the occurrence of potholes and cracks on roads, and in the road danger coefficient as well as the cost of road maintenance. In terms of road detection, powerful and efficient road recognition algorithms are utilized to realize contactless detection solutions, before which, numerous scholars had conducted extensive research in road detection. However, most road detection algorithms are tailed to road vehicle detection, instead of road surface detection. This paper proposes a novel training dataset and employs Alexnet Network to accurately detect road surface conditions in different environments. The algorithm also uses several evaluation parameters to calculate the accuracy of the algorithm (expand). The goal of this paper is to develop an efficient algorithm for the detection and recognition of road conditions in various situations, provide reliable road conditions, and simultaneously offer effective environment perception for the automatic driving system of vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Business Model of Organizational Decision Making Supported by Integrated Computer Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: There are many methods for automatic model selection in an object-oriented Intelligent Decision Support System (IDSS) model base management system. A decision support system (DSS) is a human-computer interactive system that uses data, information, and knowledge, especially model technology, to assist decision-makers at all levels in solving structured and semi-structured decision problems. The system adopts the overall architecture of the model, method library, database and session control system. This paper proposes constructing a model and method base using object-oriented technology and manages the model base concerning database management mode. The text features are decomposed into the target and initial state elements of the problem through the human-computer interaction interface. Then the intelligent recognizer is used to reason and select the model. Automatic model selection based on natural language understanding is realized by adding a problem identification module. The definition method of the model and the construction idea of the method library proposed in this paper is also helpful in designing other decision support systems.

Author Keywords: the business model of organizational decision making

articleTitle: Research on Seismic Computing System Based on Computer 3D Image Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: this paper designs a 3D image system based on seismic data. The system is based on the basic principles and processes of visualization. The system implements four modules based on Qt and OpenGL technology: seismic data management module, data analysis module, visualization module and interactive module. A brick storage method is designed to solve the problem of low efficiency of traditional seismic data reading. By reading the seismic data, the waveform display of track set, slice display of seismic data, three-dimensional display and so on are realized. A relatively complete seismic data visualization system is successfully implemented by using object-oriented language C++. The experimental simulation shows that the interface of the system is simple and the interactive operation is simple. Versatile and easy to expand.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Evolutionary Game Technology in the Prevention of Big Data Killing System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, the government regulation as the lead to establish the e-commerce platform "big data killing" pricing behavior and user consumption channel selection evolutionary game model. Then this paper based on the "java" backend design language and front-end design language "WXML" design and development of a set of price comparison small program. The system can display and compare the prices of the same goods or services on different e-commerce platforms in real time. This makes it easy for consumers to buy at the most favorable price. The evolutionary stability strategies of consumers and merchants are analyzed systematically, and the results are simulated by MATLAB software. The simulation results show that the ratio of price-sensitive old users and sticky new users as well as the fine of regulatory authorities are the key factors affecting the stable state of the evolutionary game system. Transfer costs and psychological losses can influence users' willingness to choose a "retention" strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Computer 3D Visualization Image Technology in Urban Architecture Planning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A new visualization technique for urban space is proposed. The topography and geomorphology of DGN model were studied by using MicroStation, ArcGIS and VC++. Then it introduces how to use ArcGIS to generate TIN. The original error is removed through man-machine dialogue, and the DEM result is obtained. This paper presents a complete hierarchical quadtree and aggregation data organization model. Experimental results show that this algorithm has good classification ability, and its classification accuracy can reach 98.13%. The rate of false detection and missed diagnosis were 0 and 1.87%, respectively. The proposed method has good performance.
