articleTitle: Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix-based Defect Detection Method for Photovoltaic Power Plant Panels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Conventional defect detection methods, mainly based on Photovoltaic(PV) power plant panel abnormal state data to detect panel defects, there is a certain degree of randomness in the detection results, resulting in unclear defect detection results. Therefore, the UAV imaging technology is utilized to design a defect detection method for PV power plant panels. The defect features in the image are extracted, and combined with the UAV imaging technology, the defect image is segmented from the complete image by a gray level co-generation matrix to identify the visible image defect location, and the defect image is placed in the PV panel defect detection model for further detection, so that the image texture features are highly integrated with the shape features to achieve accurate detection of PV power plant panel defects. Using comparative experiments, it was verified that the detection method has a higher confidence level and subsequently higher detection accuracy, and can be applied in real life.

articleTitle: Prediction of Length of Stay after Total Hip Arthroplasty Based on XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Total hip arthroplasty is an effective treatment for hip joint disease, but the length of stay (LOS) after surgery is an important indicator that affects patient recovery and medical expenses. Therefore, accurate prediction of LOS after total hip arthroplasty is of great significance for patient care and reasonable allocation of hospital resources. In order to overcome the subjectivity and uncertainty of traditional clinical experience prediction and the limitation of weak generalization ability of linear regression models, this study models and predicts the LOS after total hip arthroplasty based on the XGBoost algorithm, and conducts detailed data analysis and model evaluation. The results show that the XGBoost algorithm exhibits better predictive performance than traditional methods, with an average prediction error of 2.03 days, which can objectively and accurately evaluate patient conditions and predict LOS.

articleTitle: Research on artificial intelligence computer intelligent learning system under computer big data technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article uses JavaScript for language development. Using Vue framework and MySQL database, the information management system of university-enterprise cooperation sports scientific research training is designed and developed. This system includes: user login, enterprise registration, personal information management, user information management, recruitment management, training management, resume delivery management, training registration management, message consulting management and other functions. The behavior in the behavior library is modified and designed by using deviation graph technique. The three-dimensional positioning performance is simulated by using coordinate mapping and Taylor series expansion algorithm based on two-dimensional improved algorithm. The effectiveness of the system is verified by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Grab Algorithm Based on Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the development of artificial intelligence, the use of object grabbing is the direction of future development, and the grabbing method based on data processing and computer vision mode is the focus of research. The data analysis of convolution network and neural network in the mode of detection algorithm can not only effectively improve the low recognition rate, but also further improve the efficiency of object grabbing recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Federated Learning Data Management Method Based on Data Lake Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the diversified development of data information in the era of big data, the scale of data is also increasing. Due to the multi-source and heterogeneous data characteristics in the information age, the data sources are also more diverse. It is difficult to identify valid data, and data consistency cannot be guaranteed. Based on the above background, we gained a complete understanding of enterprise requirements and challenges after in-depth research on the federated learning data for data lake technology. This paper designs and implem12 -*+ents a data lake federated learning and data management system. Firstly, the application of enterprise big data is analyzed in detail, and the many deficiencies in its sources and query methods are clarified. On this basis, through in-depth customization of the unified query system, based on data lake technology and federated learning technology, the enterprise's multi-heterogeneous data system is re-planned to run stably and reliably and manage enterprise data more efficiently.

articleTitle: Application Research Based on Computer 3D Digital Photovoltaic Cable Engineering Statistics System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: in this paper, mobile geographic information system (GIS) technology is applied to photovoltaic cable lines. Combined with the characteristics of mobile phone geographic information system, a new method of photovoltaic power cable workload calculation is proposed. It is intended to use GPS real-time positioning technology to intelligently collect and display the wiring situation of solar cells and the surrounding environment. The number of photovoltaic cell wiring is quickly estimated by image approximation method. Using Dynamo's data link technology, you can quickly build a mathematical model of the cable. Dynamo visualization program was used to establish the calculation model of cable quantity. And the number of cables is calculated. The results of measurement and manual calculation are compared and analyzed with concrete examples. The research results of this paper verify the feasibility of the technical scheme.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Network Assisted Instruction Technology in College English Innovation Practice Class
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, an accurate mathematical model of English teaching topic difficulty is established. Then the maximum likelihood method is used to adjust the difficulty coefficient automatically. The adjustment method of difficulty value is described by ASP Script language based on WEB. Finally, this paper uses the multimedia platform FLASHMX and Author ware to construct the multimedia computer English teaching software. The software can realize the main functions of text learning, interactive class and fast reading. The system judges the learning level of students by intelligent diagnosis mechanism and provides favorable basis for teachers to adjust the teaching content. It is found that this system has good application prospect and is worth popularizing.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Artificial Intelligence-assisted College Public English Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper firstly studies the objective and application prospect of the independent English teaching system under the network environment. The basic functional framework of autonomous English teaching system is put forward. The software has user management module, teaching auxiliary project module, characteristic project module, grade examination module, exchange platform module, online self-test module. Finally, under the guidance of theoretical knowledge, this paper completes the test of this system. Research shows that the system improves the efficiency of English teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual College English Learning Aid System of Computer Intelligent Campus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual system for college English vocabulary assisted learning based on B/S computer. Then an image recognition method based on word context vector similarity matching and CNN+BLSTM is proposed to improve the efficiency of word retrieval algorithm. The functional elements and technical requirements of communication AIDS such as recording, storage and playback are realized by using the microcontroller AT်mega16L, MMC memory card and VS1003 audio chip. The system includes word learning module, listening learning module, reading and writing module, examination guide and excellent students' secret book module and edutainment module. The application results show that the system can realize the interaction between teachers and students before class, during class and after class, and close the connection between teachers and students. This system improves students' interest in foreign language learning and effectively promotes the improvement of teaching quality.

articleTitle: Research on Sports and Psychological Health Evaluation of College Sudents Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Clustering analysis is one of the main tasks of data mining, which can be used as an independent tool to obtain the distribution of data and classify the objects according to their characteristics. Fuzzy clustering analysis is based on the data characteristics of the object itself. According to the characteristics, closeness and similarity of the objective things, it can cluster the objective things by establishing a fuzzy similarity relationship to compare the similarity of different students' sports and psychological health. Based on the principle and method of fuzzy clustering analysis, the mathematical model is constructed, the fuzzy clustering process is designed, the evaluation index system is constructed, and the data preprocessing method is pointed out. The research results provide a complete solution for college students' sports and psychological health evaluation, and provide a reference for other fuzzy cluster evaluation.

articleTitle: Distributed optimal scheduling of a typical integrated energy system considering communication cost
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Integrated energy systems represented by electric-thermal coupling systems have the characteristics of efficient energy utilization and environmental friendliness. They are a new force in energy reform and can effectively realize the interconnectedness of multiple energy sources. The power and heating systems in the electric-thermal coupling system are under the jurisdiction of different business units, and are independently dispatched and optimized by the power dispatch center and the heating dispatch center. Therefore, traditional centralized optimization dispatch algorithms are not suitable for the production needs of the actual situation. ADMM(Alternative Direction Multiplier Method, ADMM), as an alternative algorithm, can not only meet the requirements of independent scheduling of various energy objects, but also meet the requirements of modern wireless communication transmission networks for exchanging boundary information. However, the effectiveness of ADMM is constrained by factors such as communication costs. To address this deficiency, this paper proposes a Distributed optimal scheduling of a typical integrated energy system considering communication cost. Distributed computing is based on the ADMM framework, and a communication audit mechanism is embedded in the data exchange process. Finally, through case analysis, the effectiveness of the improved ADMM with embedded communication audit mechanism is verified, which can reduce communication frequency and cost.

articleTitle: Classifying the Country of Origin of Traffic Transactions Based on Computer Raw Dataset Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Accurate network traffic classification is the key to achieve controllable and manageable Internet. This paper analyzes and compares the application of algorithm in the classification of network traffic source country. The experimental results show that logistic regression is the most efficient. SVM and neural networks take longer, probably because their algorithms are more complex. Optimize the neural network time consumption by setting the appropriate batch size. The time consumption of the three machine learning algorithm models on Precision is about 92%. In terms of Recall and F1 scores, the three machine learning algorithms mainly concentrate between 89% and 90%. There is no significant difference between the algorithm models. SVM was superior in precision (92%), recall (89%) and F1 score (90%).

articleTitle: Study on condition monitoring method of slurry circulating pump based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A slurry circulating pump is an important auxiliary equipment in a limestone gypsum desulfurization system. The normal operation of the slurry circulating pump is of great significance for the unit to meet the ultra-low discharge requirements. The reagent of the desulfurization system is limestone slurry, which makes the auxiliary equipment vulnerable to wear and blockage. As the main parameter of the slurry circulating pump, the bearing temperature can well reflect the operating state of the equipment. In this paper, the prediction model of temperature measurement points is established by using a support vector regression algorithm, and the temperature monitoring of a single temperature measurement point is realized. Secondly, considering that multiple temperature measurement point groups will fail when the temperature is abnormal, according to the actual performance characteristics of the measurement points, this paper uses the support vector machine classifier algorithm to realize the abnormal diagnosis of multiple temperature measurement point groups. The experiment with the field's actual measurement point data shows that the model proposed in this paper can realize the fault location when multiple measurement points rise abnormally.

articleTitle: High-speed overtaking trajectory planning based on multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Due In order to ensure the safety of high-speed overtaking planning and improve the trajectory comfort, a multi-objective trajectory planning algorithm for high-speed overtaking was proposed. The algorithm solves the boundary conditions of high-speed overtaking on the basis of feasible convex space, and then analyzes the feasibility of overtaking behavior through the safety overtaking strategy. Then, according to the established overtaking trajectory planning objective function and comfort optimization function, the trajectory ride comfort and other objectives are optimized, and the algorithm plans the trajectory in real time until the overtaking behavior is completed. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, Prescan and Matlab /Simulink were used to build a co-simulation platform, and two common overtaking scenarios were verified and analyzed. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the comfort and safety of the planned overtaking trajectory compared with the single objective optimization.

articleTitle: Analysis of an Efficient Classification Method Based on Density Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of information society, tens of thousands of data will be generated at any time. How to obtain valuable information from data has always been explored by scholars. As an important research field in machine learning, data classification can discover classification rules and make data prediction by analyzing the training set of known categories. In order to solve the problem of multi-classification unbalanced data, we use DPC-based data preprocessing method to optimize the classifier, and select three mainstream classifiers, namely random forest, decision tree, k-nearest neighbor and support vector machine model for analysis and research. It is worth noting that in the KNN model, we use the weighted KNN algorithm based on kernel function for prediction training. Specifically, this paper first uses DPC algorithm to quickly select the cluster center, and selects the optimal clipping threshold through experiments to pry the training set, uses the optimized training set to train and optimize the classifier, and finally uses the classifier to predict the test set. In order to better test the model accuracy, we choose the 50% cross test. Experimental results show that the optimization algorithm can improve the classifier accuracy in 99.9% of the cases.

articleTitle: The Detection of Hexapod Robot Based on Arduino Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Mobile robots are the most important branch in the field of robotics. With the rapid development of modern science and technology, the research focus of robots has gradually shifted from crawler robots and wheeled robots in mobile robots to legged robots. The hexapod robot was developed with careful consideration of the characteristics of insect limb movement and its limb branches are designed to be highly effective for its intended purpose. It exhibits motion stability and adaptability in harsh terrain, making it a prime area of research for multi-legged robots in the modern era. The hexapod robot's exceptional environmental adaptability and efficiency have revolutionized environmental detection in the modern era. In this paper, a motion command scheme is proposed to realize the control of the hexapod robot to complete the basic movement and the adjustment function of various operating postures in order to realize the stable operation and control. In addition, we have conducted a lot of tests to verify the performance of the robot and the test results show that it has good performance.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Control System for Photovoltaic Cleaning Intelligent Robot Based on 5G Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Solar energy is increasingly becoming a focus of development in various countries, and the number of photovoltaic modules powered by solar energy is increasing year by year. However, the power generation efficiency of photovoltaic modules is affected by various environmental factors such as surface ash. This article focuses on the cleaning problem of surface ash in photovoltaic modules, and designs a new photovoltaic autonomous cleaning robot based on a traveling current blocking mechanism, combined with a 5G intelligent communication system. The robot adopts a negative pressure adsorption tracked walking mechanism and a self-designed waterless cleaning mechanism, which can independently plan the path. By introducing the structure, working principle, and control principle of the robot, and through experiments, it has been proven that the robot can achieve 0 ° to 90 ° elevation operation and effectively improve the output power of photovoltaic panels. This solves the problems of low efficiency and high-water consumption in manual cleaning, water wheel cleaning, and other methods, and provides a basis for related research on cleaning robots.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Intelligent Whole Process Construction Information System in Large International Hub Airport Project
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to meet the information security performance requirements of large hub airports in the era of big data, the platform adopts advanced big data architecture. The Logistic mapping technology is used to digitize the database information of the international hub airport, so that the information can be folded and transformed repeatedly in the region, and the hash encryption algorithm is used to encrypt and decrypt the database information, so as to realize the security management and storage of the database information. The intrusion system provides all-weather and all-day real-time monitoring and protection of the perimeter through video surveillance and sensor network system. The system timely obtains and records the image information in the case of alarms. At the same time, without losing data packets, the peak value of single type log entry can reach 15,000 pieces per second. The packet loss rate of the system database is also low, and good information security management effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Green Cold Chain Logistics Information System under Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper combines RFID, GPS, GPRS and other communication technologies to establish a set of suitable for our national conditions of cold chain logistics status and quality monitoring system. It is used for real-time monitoring of the state and quality of fresh agricultural products during transportation. The Internet will be used to publish temperature, cargo status pictures and GPS positioning information, food status and quality information. eclipse is used as a development environment and MySQL is used as a background database. The system uses Spring MVC, MyBatis integrated architecture to complete the user management, route planning, order management and other aspects of the work. The equipment location-traffic routing problem (LRP) based on two-layer optimization is constructed. The upper goal is to minimize the total time consumed by the emergency logistics system, and the lower goal is to minimize the sum of distribution cost and time penalty cost. Experimental results show that this method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wordle Game Mechanism Based on Multi-task Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Wordle is a popular word-guessing game on Twitter, which can stimulate people’s interest in word structure and has pedagogical significance. In this paper, we analyze the game mechanics through a large amount of game data deposited in the backend of Wordle, and provide corresponding decision support for game managers. In this paper, a multi-task model (MMCL) is firstly established to combine MASK masking with contrast learning to encode words as a matrix with deep word construction features by using letters as the smallest unit; secondly, a specialized decoder is trained to realize the mapping between encoded words and difficulty coefficients by using difficulty histogram as supervision; finally, in this paper, through a systematic clustering algorithm, the words are mapped by Finally, this paper classifies the words into difficult, medium and easy levels through the difficulty coefficients mapped out by a systematic clustering algorithm. Based on this model, this paper well completes our research on word structure patterns and the psychological logic of human word construction.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Green Cold Chain Logistics of Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the process of refrigerated transportation, the freshness degree and transportation speed of fresh commodities play a crucial role in improving transportation efficiency and reducing transportation costs. This paper designs an environmental monitoring system for agricultural cold chain logistics based on statistical process control (SPC). C4.5 decision tree was used to classify each link of the supply chain, and it was integrated with the concept of statistical process management to construct a cold chain system suitable for agricultural products. The monitoring system is designed and implemented with LabVIEW to achieve better information sharing. This paper presents an information communication scheme based on cold chain logistics system, and analyzes various testing devices in cold chain logistics system. Through component library and cloud computing technology, independent functional units, remote services and reusable software resources are provided for the cold chain logistics system of fresh agricultural products. Experimental results show that this method has accurate logistics level positioning. Effective discrimination of environmental data, and has a strong quality change inversion ability.

articleTitle: Temperature Prediction Based on EAL Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Temperature prediction has certain reference significance for future warming and related extreme weather. The existing traditional models cannot capture the features of temperature time series. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of temperature time series prediction by traditional models, this paper proposes an EAL-based deep learning model to capture its features. In this paper, firstly, ARIMA and LSTM models were constructed and the temperature series were analyzed, and it was found that the prediction results were poor. Therefore, in this paper, with the help of EEMD decomposition, the fused temperature prediction model EAL is proposed, and finally a good fitting and prediction result is obtained. The three models of LSTM, ARIMA and EAL were compared, where the RMSE was 0.2912, 0.1064 and 0.0546, MAE was 0.1818, 0.0863 and 0.0277, and MAPE was 0.0131, 0.0061 and 0.002, respectively. Therefore, it was found that the EAL model in all indicators was outperformed other models and had better applicability for this field of temperature prediction.

articleTitle: Ship target detection based on YOLOv3 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As a coastal state, China's maritime trade and maritime security are crucial, and efficient and accurate detection and recognition of ships is an essential part of this. However, currently, deep learning-based ship target detection methods suffer from scarce datasets and imbalanced samples, leading to weak generalization capabilities of many detection models that are unable to adapt to a variety of environments. In this article, a new large marine ship dataset was established, and the AutoAugment data processing method was used to process ship image information. The YOLOv3 algorithm was utilized for ship target detection, improving the robustness and prediction accuracy of ship detection under complex coastal conditions, achieving high-quality detection of ships at sea.

articleTitle: Research on computer database intrusion detection based on clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper combines the idea of decision tree classification and ant colony clustering, and proposes a multilevel hybrid classifier combining decision tree and ant colony algorithms, i.e., a tree classifier improved by Algorithm C4.5 and a method combining two techniques of applying ant colony clustering algorithms to hybrid data to distinguish which are normal intrusions, and the attack data types are layered, with the first layer being normal data, the second layer being other data and the third layer is special data. Experiments show that this new method is very effective in intrusion detection, it has a very low false alarm rate, while maintaining a relatively acceptable false alarm rate, and can also be appropriate to detect unknown intrusion detection thus improving the intrusion detection rate.

articleTitle: Improved hardware acceleration of image quality simulation for optical imaging system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the field of optical imaging, image simulation is needed to evaluate the imaging performance of the system. However, traditional software-based image calculation methods have limited computational speed. This paper presents a hardware acceleration design for imaging performance simulation based on FPGA, which significantly improves computational efficiency. First, the image quality simulation algorithm of the imaging system is analyzed, and then an FPGA-based algorithm acceleration circuit is designed and implemented. For the convolution calculation module, an optimization design based on the shift circuit is proposed for the multiplication and addition circuit design scheme used in previous literature. In this paper, four different images are convolved under three different experimental conditions: pure software, traditional multiplication and addition structure, and the proposed shift and addition structure, using two sets of different PSFs. The experimental results show that compared with the pure software solution, this paper achieved a speedup of about 60 times. Compared with the traditional multiplication and addition structure, the structure proposed in this paper has zero DSP hardware resource occupancy while ensuring the same computational efficiency and accuracy. The research in this paper can accelerate the process of imaging quality simulation and can be used in multiple imaging fields such as machine vision and microscopy.

articleTitle: Research on weakening control strategy of permanent magnet synchronous motor of high speed vacuum cleaner based on sliding mode observer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The built-in permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) has been widely used in electric vehicles, aerospace, national defense, robotics, medical and other fields due to its high operating efficiency, high torque density and relatively stable running condition. Traditional IPMSM control strategy includes speed control of position sensor, magnetic field orientation control and so on. They have the limitations of increasing system cost and algorithm failure in case of sensor failure. In this paper, high-speed vacuum cleaner as the research object, aiming at the vacuum cleaner in high speed, sensorless drive motor high-speed operation ability, using sliding mode control and weak magnetic control strategy. A series of experiments and simulations are designed. The results show that the proposed sliding mode and magnetic weakening control strategies have good dynamic response and steady state response, and more accurate estimated position and estimated speed are obtained. The system has the advantages of strong robustness.

articleTitle: Adaptive Deep Inference Framework for Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) requires significant computational and storage resources, which is challenging for resource-constrained end devices. To this end, collaborative deep inference is proposed, in which the DNN is divided into two parts and deployed on end devices and cloud respectively. How to find the optimal split point for collaborative deep inference in a changing network environment is a big challenge. It is also important to reduce decision latency for model partition to achieve adaptivity. To address these challenges, in this paper, we propose an Adaptive Partition (AP) framework to achieve adaptive deep inference through cloud-edge collaboration. Considering the inference performance in different network environments, we perform a weighted joint optimization of inference latency and quantization loss so that the focus of the optimization can change adaptively with the network. Then we propose a method to make fast decision on the selection of optimal split point. Extensive experimental evaluations have demonstrated the effectiveness of AP in improving the performance of adaptive collaborative deep inference. Compared with the state-of-the-art methods, AP reduces the decision latency and the total inference latency by up to 65.0x and 2.98x.

articleTitle: Solid-state high-power amplifier power synthesis and failure analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper summarizes the solid-state high power amplifier briefly, studies the influence of devices failure through the derivation of scattering matrix, and verifies and analyzes in a Ku-band high power amplifier.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Aided Digital Design and 3D Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal design scheme for the motor control system of FDM3D printers based on computer digital technology. Taking the Cortex-M4 microcontroller as the main research object, a computer simulation system based on RT-Thread is established. Combining S-type acceleration with Bresenham's linear interpolation method for stepping motor control. The corresponding program modules are designed. The content includes data storage, human-computer interaction, serial communication and debugging, and control of stepper motors. Through the experiment on the action commands issued by the mobile phone, it was found that the 3D printer can respond quickly and correctly. The system has the characteristics of high efficiency, precision and real-time.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Power System Equipment Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology is used to analyze various faults in power grid. First, the PTZ camera is used to shoot each device in the power grid, and the captured device image is transmitted to the remote monitoring center. The image of the device is intercepted and preprocessed by the remote monitoring center. A fault detection algorithm based on variational modes is established to extract the fault detection signal of power grid equipment from the image and input it into SVM for learning, so as to achieve the purpose of fault detection and diagnosis of power grid equipment. Simulation results show that the proposed method can accurately identify various faults in power grids under extreme weather conditions such as haze and heavy snow.

articleTitle: Development of Employee Information Management System Based on B/S Mode and SQL Server Database
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Big data and information technology, this paper designs an employee information management system based on B/S mode and SQL Server database. Proposed the B/S mode architecture design and the functional module design of the employee information management system, analyzed the association rules of the SQL Server database, and detailed the design and development process of the employee information management system database using SQL Server software, which can achieve various functions such as employee information collection, query, and update.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wordle Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This study addresses the WORDLE model problem by exploring how to construct appropriate short- and medium-term forecasting models. Firstly, by selecting data with recent stable trends as training and test data, the data are normalised and a combination of genetic algorithms, grid search and manual tuning is used to select suitable LSTM model parameters for forecasting. During the validation process, the R-square of the test set was approximately 67%. Based on the model predictions, the number of reports on 1 March 2023 is expected to be between 18,408 and 28,124. Secondly, four characteristic attributes were chosen as judgement indicators: number of letter repetitions, proximity of repeated letters, spelling rules and familiarity. It was not determined whether there were other features with high explanatory power that were not selected for this model, such as whether the player completed the task independently. Spearman correlation analysis was then conducted and found no correlation between these factors. In addition, principal component analysis, canonical correlation analysis and regression analysis were used as ideas in this paper. After extracting the selected word features, partial least squares regression was used to predict the percentage of occurrences of a particular word (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X) on a future day. After tenfold cross-validation, the model generalised very well. Finally, this model was used to predict the corresponding percentage of the word "eerie" on March 1, 2023, with a high degree of confidence in the predicted results.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Reported Results of Wordle Based on ARIMA and GBDT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Wordle is a simple but addictive scrabble game run by The New York Times, in which players have to guess a five-letter solution word in six attempts. Many people share their experiences and today's scores on Twitter. In this paper, the results shared by players on Twitter from January 7, 2022 to December 31, 2022 are crawled. ARMA(5,6) and ARMA(5,7) are constructed based on time sequence analysis and heat map to analyze the change of the number of reported results over time. And a forecast interval of the number of reported results on March 1, 2023 is given. Furthermore, this study adopts the Grand causality test to analyze the relationship between the word attributes, the frequency of usage, and the percentage of reported scores in Hard Mode. It was found that the attributes of words 1 and 2 days ago would have an impact on the percentage data of that day. This paper also constructs the Gradient Boosting decision tree model and predicts the distribution of results corresponding to a given date and a given solution word.

articleTitle: Currency Recognition Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Currency recognition is a critical task with diverse applications. Recent advancements in deep learning and neural networks have shown significance in improving its accuracy and robustness. This paper presents an approach that utilizes the convolutional neural network (CNN) for accurate and reliable currency recognition. The paper begins with an introduction to the background of the neural network, including its architecture and types, focusing on CNN and its significance in image-processing tasks. Then, the methodology section describes the data collection process, dataset preparation, and the construction of the CNN model. Next, the results and discussion section present the performance of the developed model, discusses the accuracy of the model, and figure out the model’s strengths and areas for improvement. Last, the conclusion summarizes the research findings and evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed neural network-based approach, while also suggesting directions for future research. Overall, the study demonstrates the potential of CNNs in currency recognition and provides insights for further development in this field.

articleTitle: Research on the Auxiliary System of University Mathematics Teaching Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a 3D dynamic assisted teaching system for advanced mathematics based on virtual reality technology. The system uses XHTML + MathML + SVG framework to solve the problems of Web mathematical information including text, mathematical formulas and mathematical graphics in XHTML documents and text and mathematical formulas in SVG documents. Secondly, the functional structure, network structure and database of the system are designed. The autocorrelation characteristic quantity of advanced mathematics auxiliary teaching resources is extracted. The fuzzy correlation feature matching and statistical analysis method are used to realize the adaptive optimization of advanced mathematics assisted teaching resource fusion. At last, the data mining technology is used to design the mathematics teaching database and store the teaching information and resources. The system test shows that the teaching system has higher accuracy than the traditional system.

articleTitle: Research on visible light communication transceiver and processing module
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the visible light communication transmitter module based on LED, the visible light communication receiver module based on photoelectric detector and the embedded digital communication processing module of the visible light communication system. The developed module will carry the individual helmet and on-board optical platform, build the optical structure of downlink single-directional transmission and uplink omnidirectional reception, realize the two-way visible optical communication link between on-board optical nodes, realize the wireless optical communication between ground personnel and between ground personnel and armored vehicles, explore the new mode of modern battlefield short-range communication, and improve the convenience, mobility and reliability of tactical communication, Promote the tactical play of armored units.

articleTitle: Analysis of Distributed Sharing System of Higher Education Resources Based on Artificial Intelligence Background
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper introduces the development ideas and software and hardware requirements of the teaching information service platform in colleges and universities. This paper introduces the overall design of a university information resource sharing platform based on Internet and with large database as the core. The system uses the latest Internet/Intranet technology to realize the integration and sharing of teaching resources between different schools. Then a general scheduling model is proposed to solve the scheduling problem between resource center and user task in distributed sharing system of educational resources. The correctness of the proposed algorithm is proved by simulation experiments. It shortens the user's working cycle and improves the system's working efficiency.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Application of Face Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, face recognition technology is developing rapidly, it has a broad future prospect and many scholars have formed some scientific research results, which makes the technology develop rapidly in various industries. By reviewing several literatures, there is still a lack of relevant research that elaborates on face recognition technology, so this paper will be based on an in-depth study of face recognition technology. This research will provide a comprehensive analysis of face recognition systems, their main components and principles, some examples of face recognition algorithms and an analysis of their advantages and disadvantages, and a comprehensive analysis of the problems that exist at this stage of the technology. The article concludes with a summary and outlook of the whole paper.

articleTitle: Research on the application of Artificial Intelligence in the detection system of personality and psychological characteristics of minority students and the screening system of suitable sports items
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The Tarim region is a multi-ethnic region with large differences in temperament and character among various ethnic groups. In order to understand the ethnic characteristics of the nervous types of Han, Uyghur, Kazak, Mongolian, Kirgiz and Xibe college students in the Tarim region, and the differences in personality and temperament among ethnic groups, Eysenck personality questionnaire was used to test and compare the sports psychological indicators of 516 college students, and the artificial intelligence system was optimized to solve the problem of sports intervention based on artificial intelligence. In addition, the application of artificial intelligence method to solve the problem of national sports suitable items is introduced in detail.

articleTitle: EU-BERT: Efficient Unified Named Entity Recognition via Multi-exit BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is an important Natural Language Processing (NLP) task with wide application, such as document analysis, knowledge graph and query understanding. Although pretrain-based language models such as BERT has achieved great results on NER task, the large amount of parameters of BERT makes it slow during inference, which limits its usage in industry. Experiments show that the metric of traditional early exiting has great defects. In this work, we propose EU-BERT, an Efficient Unified named entity recognition framework via multi-exit BERT, to accelerate BERT inference on NER task. To handle nested and discontinuous NER tasks, we adopt W2NER [1], a unified NER framework using table filling technique. EU-BERT proposes a better metric for early exiting and uses contrastive learning to enhance its ability. Experiments on 9 benchmark NER datasets demonstrate that our method can improve the performance of multi-exit BERT on NER task while maintaining its inference speed.

articleTitle: Mixed Reality and Deep Learning Theory Applied in Radio Frequency Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The mixed reality and deep learning theory is applied in the radio frequency management domain. The electromagnetic enhanced situation is formed by superposing the fictitious electromagnetic information on the actual frequency station and environment. The dynamic interaction between the frequency managers and the cognitive radio equipment is realized by directly operating the frequency domain characteristics which are relied on the immersed tactile equipment. The long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network is used to predict the frequency usage condition. It is conducive to realize the dynamic frequency share and solve the problems of limited frequency resource. This is helpful to promote the metaverse theory to be applied in the frequency intelligent management field.

articleTitle: Electric power information communication system based on information collection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies a power information communication system, including the area chain A, which is used to collect and cache power information in real time; the data identification module, which is used to assign independent data identification for power information by using source code; the data transmission channel configuration module, It is used to configure the corresponding transmission channel for each power information according to the data identification of the power information; the data storage module is used to set an independent logical number for the power information, and store the power information in the corresponding data storage unit. This paper adopts the method of data category identification and logical storage number to realize multi-type data fusion storage and flexible output of electric power data. Different transmission channels are used based on different data. At the same time, each channel is equipped with status monitoring and transmission channel independent construction modules. , which can well avoid the interruption of data transmission due to the failure of the transmission channel; at the same time, the release and sharing of data is realized through the regional chain, thereby ensuring the security of the data.

articleTitle: A hardware architecture design for interference rejection of ultrasound signals based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Ultrasonic sensing and imaging technology based on the working principle of ultrasound has a wide range of applications in several practical application scenarios, such as spatial ranging, metal flaw detection, and medical diagnosis. In practical applications, the ultrasonic signal is emitted through the ultrasonic transducer. Then the reflected acoustic signal is detected, while the information related to the received reflected wave is displayed on the monitor, and theoretical analysis is performed, thus realizing the contactless and non-invasive detection of the object under test. However, in practical scenarios, the detected reflected signals often carry electromagnetic interference or spurious acoustic signals generated by machines or environmental factors, thus affecting the accurate analysis of the detected object. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes the design of an ultrasonic signal spurious suppression circuit structure based on a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), thus realizing high-speed processing and real-time imaging of ultrasonic signals. The experimental results show that the design can effectively remove the interference signal and improve the image signal-to-noise ratio by more than three times; meanwhile, the hardware computing structure can achieve more than 6000 times of computational acceleration ratio compared with the existing software-based computing scheme. This study can be widely applied to various measurement instruments and has important application value.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Based on ERNIE-BiLSTM-CRF
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Named entity recognition, as well as the knowledge extraction of text data, is one of the important tasks of information mining. However, due to the unique text structure and word distribution of some specific sentences, the traditional models cannot well inject the related entities into the exact representation. To better represent entities by word vectors to improve the annotation performance of named entities of the model, this paper proposes an ERNIE-BiLSTM-CRF model. Firstly, the dynamic word vectors of text input are obtained by ERNIE pre-trained model, and then the corresponding feature vectors are acquired through BiLSTM, and finally, the features are decoded and the label sequence is calculated by CRF. The experiment result shows that the Precision, Recall, and F1-score of the proposed model are 69.74%, 66.55%, and 68.10% respectively, which proves the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Big Data Information Monitoring System Based on Computer Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The communication information acquisition system has the problem of high packet loss rate. This paper designs an intelligent communication big data information monitoring system based on genetic algorithm. Through the built-in Transmission Control protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) stack, additional pins are selected as the carrier of the register and connected to the circuit. Through the design of environmental information communication software architecture, coordination node program and terminal node program, the environmental communication software system is designed. The wireless communication network is selected as the network module of the communication information monitoring system, and combined with the transmission link balanced configuration method, the communication information monitoring data is sent and received and the communication route is designed. The simulation results show that the overall stability of the system is superior. The output results are accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Design and Application of ESC Hydraulic Control Unit Test System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper introduces the test system of ESC hydraulic control unit based on Freescale mc9s12xs128mal, The test methods of conventional braking performance, ABS braking performance, active braking performance, ABS braking durability and active braking durability of ESC hydraulic control unit are described in detail. The test system does not rely on communication protocol, which is completely different from the existing test methods in the automotive industry. It tests in a more intuitive way, and the test method and test system are innovative. The practical results show that the system runs stably, the pulse voltage control of solenoid valve is accurate, and the data acquisition of input hydraulic pressure, output hydraulic pressure and pulse voltage is real-time. The curves of output hydraulic pressure, pulse voltage and time history measured in the test are stable and reliable, which can meet the requirements of ESC hydraulic control unit test of main engine manufacturers and parts manufacturers.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Music Symphony Creation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the creation of symphonic movement, a set of performing method using deep neural network is put forward. Its research value lies in the ability to obtain more music information in less time. In the aspect of data preprocessing, first extracted from Music XML symphony music pictures for training and corresponding tag information. The music score is analyzed using the deep network based on Darknet53. An automatic music generation method based on Darknet53 is proposed. The results show that using depth LSTM, Bi-LSTM and attention mechanism can extract music information more efficiently. The conclusion of this paper can provide help for the composer's auxiliary creation to a large extent.

articleTitle: Overview of Image Classification Methods Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Image classification is a method of classifying different categories of objects based on the different characteristics of objects in an image. Most of the traditional image classification algorithms use shallow structures, which have obvious deficiencies in performance and generalization ability. The image classification algorithm based on convolutional neural network has good performance indicators and can solve the image classification problem well.

articleTitle: Fault identification method of power network equipment based on fusion neural network model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies a fault identification method and system of power grid equipment based on the fusion neural network model. The method includes: obtaining several power parameters representing the operation status of power grid equipment in the line of power grid equipment to be identified as eigenvalues and pre-processing; The pre-processed eigenvalues are input into the pre-established fusion neural network model to obtain the fault probability of the power grid equipment line to be identified. In view of the fact that the fault identification of power grid equipment is easily affected by the noise of signal transmission, this paper proposes a fault identification method and system of power grid equipment based on the fusion neural network model, which makes full use of the advantages of artificial intelligence, gives full play to the role of big data of power grid equipment operation, excavates the correlation between operation data and fault characteristics, and comprehensively diagnoses power grid equipment through multi-dimensional information, It can effectively reduce the impact of signal transmission noise or error on the accuracy of fault identification and improve the safety of power grid equipment operation.

articleTitle: Application of Support Vector Machine in Health Assessment of Shipborne Radar Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Shipborne antennas are important equipment to ensure the completion of aerospace measurement ship missions. Due to long-term operation under complex and harsh conditions, key components such as motors, gears, bearings, and other mechanical equipment will inevitably fail, causing serious safety hazards and directly affecting the completion of the mission. This paper analyzes the role and significance of the antenna health management system, introduces the theory of support vector machine, establishes the model and application framework of support vector machine, implements the mathematical model in the antenna health management system, and verifies the feasibility of the model through the antenna measured data validation.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Film Music Creation System Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This project intends to start from the theory of Bayesian networks, centering on the important characteristics of beat, pitch and intensity in film and television works, to explore the uncertainty factors in film and television works. At the same time, the creation and analysis of film and television music works. The knowledge base based on this model is constructed and the rhythm and tone inference algorithm based on this model is given. A semi-supervised algorithm based on this algorithm is presented. A new interactive mode of film and television soundtrack is established based on multilevel Bayesian network and corpus knowledge base and database storage program. The creation and arrangement of film and television works are studied in detail with the theory of Bayesian net. This paper verifies it. Experimental results show that the algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Research for the state of lithium-ion battery health based on data-driven method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The state of lithium-ion battery health (SOH) is indicative of the current comprehensiveness of lithium-ion batteries, such as their storage and output capabilities. The tools which use lithium-ion battery as power source need to collect real-time data on battery voltage, resistance, current, and so on. The higher the frequency of data collection is, the higher the cost will be. In order to ensure the accuracy of battery SOH estimation and reduce the cost of data acquisition. In this paper, based on the simulated laboratory environment, charge-discharge experiments of different frequency under different charge-discharge ratio are designed. Local weighted linear regression (LWLR) algorithm was used to estimate the declining trend of health features for lithium batteries. The maximum information coefficient (MIC) algorithm is used to measure the correlation between health characteristics and capacity. Finally, BI-LSTM-based neural networks will further investigate the nonlinear degradation relationship between learning capacity and health characteristics. The maximum relative error of off-line estimation of Battery SOH is 1.601%.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in 5G Wireless Transmission Fault Intelligent Diagnosis System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper designs a wireless robot communication fault monitoring device based on 5G band. Set the required hardware and signal acquisition frequency of wireless robot signal acquisition module. Set the 5G frequency band communication structure of the monitoring device. The 5G frequency band communication fault monitoring algorithm is set to complete the wireless robot communication fault location. Using VB to develop remote fault diagnosis system to monitor the running state of wireless transmission center. The extracted system parameters and alarm information are classified. The simulation results show that this method has good adaptive performance, good channel balance and strong signal output control.

articleTitle: A Combined Topology of EV Wireless Charging System to Achieve Dual Parking Power Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the electric vehicle wireless power transfer (EV-WPT) system, due to the limited power capacity of switching devices, a single high-frequency inverter can no longer meet the power transmission requirements of wireless charging of high-power electric vehicles, and the existing technology rarely considers the power utilization ratio of wireless charging spot for electric vehicles. By adopting the dual-emission power distribution type wireless charging spot with single-pole double-throw (SPDT) switches, the use efficiency and utilization ratio of charging spot can be effectively improved. Based on the power expansion control method of cascade inverter, the power distribution and power expansion of wireless charging spot are realized. This method can better promote the application of EV-WPT.

articleTitle: Wisdom Tower Crane Network Control System Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the working efficiency of tower crane workers and reduce the probability of on-site accidents, the team established a set of intelligent tower crane network operating system based on 5G technology. The system uses MATLAB software to build a network platform including visual perception system, 5G communication transmission system and intelligent operating system. The intelligent tower crane network control system obtains image data through the visual perception system, exchanges monitoring data and operation instructions through the 5G communication transmission system, and finally realizes the intelligent and automatic operation of the tower crane through the intelligent operating system. The duplex communication technology, multi-carrier technology and cloud computing technology of the 5G communication system enable the staff to realize the real-time monitoring of various perspectives of the tower crane and the timely transmission of signals through the 5G network, so as to achieve the effect of remote real-time operation of the tower crane on the ground. The smart tower crane network control system has been successfully applied to the actual production, and in the construction process, the cost of largescale wiring and construction and installation personnel has been saved, and rapid construction has also been realized, which greatly shortens the project construction period and saves project time and labor costs.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of College Students’ Behavior Based on SSAS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With big data technology, the potential and valuable rules can be mined from the behavioural data of college students to provide scientific decision-making for teaching and management, which is conducive to comprehensively improving management and education service level of college students. Based on the data collection, processing and mining algorithm of SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services), this paper conducts intelligent analysis and research on college students’ behaviours. The massive data of students’ learning, consumption, socializing, surfing and borrowing, and wireless network access data accumulated are from the Smart campus of Jianghan University. To realize the analysis, prediction and early warning management of student behaviour, to provide scientific support for the precision of management.

articleTitle: The Design of Black Screen Alarm Message Monitoring System Based on Java by ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The use of ANN, a new advanced tool which called artificial neural networks, would been to simulate to determine the design the Black screen alarm message monitoring system based on java. The in putter layer are message gathering, message subscription, message advancement and system management, respectively, the outputer laryer is the Black screen alarm message monitoring system. The results show that the best network construction to be 4-9-1 while the momentum factor is 0.6 and learing rate is 0.8. Furthermore, the Sensitivity analysis (SA) show that system management is the most important parameter for the ANN model accuracy, the effect of message gathering, message subscription, message advancement are negative.

articleTitle: Virtual human driving method based on motion capture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the field of computer technology, explores how to use the Motion capture system to drive virtual characters, and conducts in-depth analysis of related configurations. In order to achieve this goal, the measures taken in this paper include: predicting the rules, building the relationship between the system and the virtual character skeleton on this basis, and clarifying the relationship between the two; Collect user data and clarify virtual bone data based on a clear mapping relationship; Define the initial data of the virtual character, and use interpolation to optimize the action of the virtual character and drive the character, so that the character can make accurate actions on the basis of defining the relevant data. The Motion capture system is used to collect the data of the virtual skeleton, and on the basis of fully clarifying the relevant data, the interpolation is used to optimize the action and drive of the virtual character, so that the virtual skeleton will not appear obvious jitter, and the virtual character can perform the action more accurately and smoothly.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Information Hotel Front-End Storage Database Integrated Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Firstly, this paper uses SQLServer2008 database to store data to design and implement the hotel integrated management system. Then this paper introduces a data structure to realize the continuous storage of multiple books and multi-channel data at the front end of the hotel, and gives the definition of the data structure and related algorithms. Finally, this paper implements modules including main process, protocol processing, event driver and so on, which is used to build a complete hotel front-end data cache system under Linux environment. Experiments show that the virtual core performance of the hotel front-end data stream cache is improved by 9.4% on average under the configuration of the front-end width of 4 instructions and the capacity of the instruction window of 512. Program performance improved by up to 28%.

articleTitle: LPIXray: A Large-scale Logistics Prohibited Item X-ray Dataset for the Application of Deep Learning in Security Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Detecting prohibited items in X-ray images is very important for logistics public safety. For object detection, deep learning with the support of a significant volume of data has enormous advantages and has gradually become a mainstream research method. However, there are relatively few public datasets on prohibited item X-ray images, and the existing datasets have the problem of fewer prohibited items in quantity and variety. To address the above challenges, this work contributes LPIXray dataset: a Logistics Prohibited Item X-ray dataset. The LPIXray contains 60950 X-ray images of prohibited items, 84785 instances, and is carefully divided into 6 classes with 18 subclasses. These X-ray images cover almost all common prohibited item categories, and each category has a wealth of data annotation. The LPIXray dataset is 6 or even 20 times larger than previous datasets, far exceeding previous data in terms of annotation quantity and category definition. Aiming at the problem that some X-ray images of prohibited item are difficult to collect and the samples are unbalanced, a data Augmentation approach based on the General Adversarial Network (GAN) and image fusion is designed. Finally, we conduct experimental verification on the LPIXray dataset based on You Only Look Once (YOLO) model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Knowledge Graph Algorithm for Electricity Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: When employees of electricity companies want to know relevant information in the electricity field in real time, such as the latest policies, news, standards, cases, etc., traditional information retrieval alone cannot meet people's needs for fast and accurate knowledge acquisition. This paper introduces electricity knowledge graph as auxiliary information to help knowledge recommendation. To maintain the freshness and completeness of knowledge recommendation, it is necessary to improve the freshness of knowledge graph, thus we study the dynamic updating method of knowledge graph before knowledge recommendation in electricity field. First, we study the dynamic updating method of the knowledge graph in the electricity field, and then continues to study the knowledge recommendation method based on the knowledge graph that can be dynamically updated. In the automatic updating part of the knowledge graph, the missing information is supplemented according to the existing information in the knowledge graph to achieve internal updating. When the known knowledge is limited and it is difficult to further supplement by inferring the missing knowledge, the hot new knowledge is discovered according to the network new word discovery, and the domain entity is identified, the dynamic multivariate attribute labeling algorithm (DWAL) is added to the knowledge graph to update the knowledge. Considering the dynamic of knowledge recommendation, this paper introduces a time correction factor in the process of user interest modeling to dynamically reflect the changes of users' interests, which successfully reflects the dynamic changes of users' interests and ultimately improves the quality of recommendation.

articleTitle: Deep neural network-based (BMI) brain-computer interface system design : Development and evaluation of a BMI brain-computer interface learning framework for rehabilitation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the brain-computer interface is an important way of existing and future medical rehabilitation medicine, based on the very important role played by motor rehabilitation after stroke, the research framework based on reinforcement learning (RL) deep neural networks (BMI) brain-computer interface decoder utilizes an internal reward decoding framework and metrics to transform the mapping relationship between motor and rehabilitation. The brain is allowed to travel a customized set of learning mechanisms to identify the rewarding process with the correct behavior in a new task. This internal guidance can be used as an external reference. Data systems research can improve rehabilitation efficiency by 9%. The accuracy rate is up to 92%. And as a separate research and treatment modality. This study is based on the design of a deep neural network-based (BMI) brain-machine interface system, which is experimented with in both online and offline research directions, with 9 subjects (5 male, 4 female), aged between 25 and 34 years old, wearing 32-guided joint electrode caps on their heads, all with a resistance of 5kΩ or less. The glasses were 40cm~90cm away from the screen, the chief operating range and procedure were set in advance, and the sampling frequency of the Neuroscan-NuAmps EEG acquisition instrument was set at 250Hz. the tests were verified and improved. The research results of this paper have been applied for a patent and granted.

articleTitle: Multimodal emotion recognition based on long-distance modeling and multi-source data fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the prevalence of social media, people are increasingly inclined to express emotions in various forms such as text, images, audio, and video, which has made emotion recognition tasks more complex and challenging. Although traditional deep learning algorithms such as CNN and RNN have been widely used in multimodal emotion recognition, there are still challenges in fusing multimodal features and handling long-distance dependencies which affect the accuracy of emotion classification. To address these issues, this paper proposes a multimodal emotion recognition model based on long-distance modeling and multi-source data fusion. The model uses Transformer to encode concatenated multimodal feature vectors, and uses multi-head attention mechanism for feature fusion. It also introduces cross-layer residual connections to enhance the model's generalization ability. Finally, a multilayer perceptron is used to learn the complex relationship between feature vectors and achieve more accurate emotion classification results. The results on the IEMOCAP dataset show that the model's average accuracy reaches 59.3% and F1 value reaches 56.8%. Compared with the baseline methods, the proposed model improves the accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness in emotion recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Communication Base Station Traffic Prediction Model Based on EMD-RF-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this article, an innovative communication base station traffic prediction model is proposed for efficiently and accurately predicting traffic data. The model combines empirical mode decomposition (EMD), Transformer neural network, and random forest feature importance (RF-FI) methods. This article provides a reliable prediction model for the construction and maintenance of future communication network base stations, which is expected to have significant practical applications. Firstly, the EMD method decomposes the time series signal of the base station into feature quantities of different frequencies. Then, the importance of features is evaluated using the RF-FI method. The feature with the highest score is selected and trained on the Transformer model to predict the new sequence. Experimental results demonstrate a significant increase in forecasting accuracy (87%) and better overall performance compared to single use of the Transformer model and other time series forecasting models such as the LSTM model. Overall, this communication base station traffic prediction model is an effective and reliable solution for predicting traffic data, providing practical approaches to base station construction and maintenance, and valuable insights for future research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Performance of Linked Independent Component Analysis: Investigating the Influence of Subjects and Modalities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, neuroimaging studies have increasingly been acquiring multiple modalities of data. The benefit of integrating multiple modalities through fusion lies in its ability to combine the unique strengths of each modality when analyzed collectively, as opposed to examining each one individually. In 2011, Adrian R. Groves proposed the Linked independent component analysis (LICA) method, which simultaneously models and discovers common features across multiple modalities. LICA has emerged as a powerful technique for analyzing multivariate data, particularly in neuroimaging and biomedical signal processing. The performance of LICA can be affected by the number of subjects and modalities. However, the detailed influence of the number of subjects and modalities on its performance remains an open question. In this study, we test the effects of the number of subjects and modalities on the performance of LICA using both simulated multimodal MRI data and the real multimodal MRI datasets from Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE II).
