Simulated data were utilized to evaluate the influence of subjects and modalities' variabilities. Real multi-site MRI data were used to demonstrate the advantages of multimodal fusion in identifying site-related components and removing site effects. Based on the simulation results, we found that increasing the number of modalities and subjects can improve the results when LICA can not recover the spatial maps or subject courses well. The correlation among subject courses from various modalities, the number of modalities, and the choice of components for decomposition all affect the linking performance of LICA. Our results from real-world datasets also demonstrated the advantages of multimodal fusion by LICA: 1) identify more site-related components; 2) remove more site effects.

articleTitle: Application of Reproductive Genetics: Genetic Algorithm Research and Information System Modeling Based on Gastrointestinal Cancer and Brain Like Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Reproductive genetics examination or diagnosis is an emerging clinical discipline. The diagnostic results of reproductive genetics are the basic basis for eugenics and assisted reproductive medicine. The research team used reproductive genetics technology to propose a data collection model for susceptibility genes of gastrointestinal cancer in the neonatal stage, and formed a data processing mechanism using neural networks. Through the output data, an intelligent system was used to execute the defendant's emotional judgment method. At the same time, this neural network also includes data processing methods for gene mutations caused by various reasons in the later stage. Deep neural networks can identify the above data, and the trained neural network can output the predicted probability of cancer occurrence. At the same time, the research team proposed a sampling device for biomimetic engineering based on cutting-edge technologies in intelligent information systems, and completed road planning for the transportation mechanism of the sampling device through genetic algorithms. At the same time, we also completed the primary model design of the control system for this engineering device through mathematical modeling. The research team conducted experimental design for the occurrence of gastrointestinal cancer and processed data through SPSS, In addition, psychological experiments were designed to verify the feasibility of artificial intelligence systems affecting and intervening in authentication work in human emotional neuroscience. The research team reported and analyzed the results. The focus of this article includes the model of brain engineering, the design of biomimetic systems, and the mathematical mechanism of genetic algorithm solving.

articleTitle: Research on credit-risk models via machine-learning algorithms and logistic regression for predicting CBA consumer behaviour
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Start with the pre-screening of a possible application and continuing through the account's administration during its life and potential write-off, risk assessment techniques are used to handle things a borrower's account. Typically, a logistic regression model is used to estimate how risky it is to lend money to a credit applicant. However, researchers have also looked at a variety of other classifiers, and while early results indicate that support vector machines are the most accurate, practical implementation of these results from the lab may be hampered by issues with data quality. With a regression-based R2 values of forecasted/realized tardiness of 85%, this article generates out-of-sample predictions that greatly increase the categorization rates of credit-card holder defaults and delinquencies. We estimate the cost reductions to range from 6% to 25% of total losses using conservative estimates for the costs and benefits of reducing credit lines based on machine-learning projections.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Mutual Authentication Protocol for Smart Grid under Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of smart grid technology, The relationships between utility providers and their customers over electricity use have increased. Nonetheless, because the readings are performed through the Internet, there is a likelihood that the information will be conceded if it enters into the indicators of the wrong individuals. Furthermore, because they do not have access to the readings, consumers sometimes do not understand why they pay exorbitant fees or which gadgets consume the most power. In this article, To eliminate challenges, the autonomous blockchain technology that enables accountability and attribution, is deployed. A smart contract is also created, which performs preset tasks in order to build a trust-based mechanism among network participants. Our method is extremely efficient since the user can see how the electricity is used. The proposed smart contracts are extensively explained, and they comprise energy injection into smart networks, energy bidding to submit energy demand, energy trading, and energy use. It dynamically assigns weights to each predictor based on forecasting efficacy for the final judgement on predicting the outcome of these forecasters. Even in the presence of highly changing and ambiguous load patterns, the proposed model remains valid robust and accurate.

articleTitle: Collusion-Resistant Editable Blockchain with Punishment for Malicious Behavior Using Chameleon Hash Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Chameleon hash algorithm makes editable blockchain possible. Many editable blockchain schemes have achieved that malicious behavior of editors will be reported and punished, without considering the additional burden and workload caused by malicious reporting. Additionally, there is a possibility that miners conspire to attack and get permission. We introduced a new scheme based on chameleon hash algorithm, reputation mechanism, encrypted secret sharing mechanism and digital signature. Our scheme can not only punish the malicious behavior of editors, but also resist malicious reports and punish malicious whistle-blowers. In addition, our scheme manages to resist collusion attacks by miners. Theory and practice show that the proposed scheme has higher security, fast calculation speed, and practical application value.

articleTitle: CKF-based PMSM local demagnetization fault diagnosis method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A CKF-based PMSM local demagnetization fault diagnosis method is proposed for the problem that the on-board permanent magnet synchronous motor is prone to permanent magnet demagnetization faults due to the strong armature reaction under various complex operating conditions. A model of local demagnetization fault in permanent magnet synchronous motor combined with volumetric Kalman filter is constructed to realize the qualitative and quantitative description of fault characteristics. Then, by analyzing the air gap density of the motor when the local demagnetization fault occurs, comparing the Fourier spectrum of the air gap density before and after the fault, the harmonic components of different demagnetization fault degrees are summarized and summarized, and finally, by analyzing the magnetic chain signal and judging whether the local demagnetization occurs by the threshold value of the fault. The experimental results in Matlab/simulink simulation prove that the demagnetization fault diagnosis module can achieve high-quality diagnosis of local demagnetization faults by analyzing the DC components of the barrier features after volumetric Kalman filtering. The research results provide new ideas on the problem of fault-tolerant control of local demagnetization faults.

articleTitle: IUCNet: A Novel Semantic Segmentation Network for Overlapping Industrial Parts Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: General-purpose segmentation methods networks are difficult to adapt to more complex industrial scenes based on convolutional neural, such as industrial parts with more stacking, tilting, and occlusion cases. This paper’s 2D image dataset with multiple scene occlusions is constructed using two common types of parts, bolts, and shims. Based on this, a semantic segmentation method, IUCNet, is validated with excellent and stable results. This method selects UperNet as the model, ConvNeX as the backbone network, and the combination of Dice Loss and Cross Entropy as the loss function, based on the excellent performance in other segmentation tasks. Meanwhile, we also introduce a photometric distortion pre-processing module to solve the blurring of overlapping edges caused by shadows and similar colors in industrial part images. Our method finally obtains an average IoU of 91.32 and an average PA of 96.17 in the self-built image test set.

articleTitle: Gaussian Process for the Machine Learning-based Smart Fire Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, imaging devices, and computer vision are a few examples of contemporary technology that potentially replace traditional methods fire-detection systems with vision-based ones, thereby ensuring society's fire safety. Using the computer-aided system for quick and accurate fire detection could prevent a large-scale fire. Fire detection models perform poorly because they do not take into account the analysis of the fire particles (also known as pattern recognition) or the numerous moving objects in the background. To resolve this issue and concentrate a fire improvement in light of worldly edges from a film, this study gives a powerful even reenactment model of dynamic fire and a half-and-half fire division. In the model's preprocessing step, the candidate fire and non-fire Areas are segmented with the Hue-Saturation-Value (HSV) colour space and the Gaussian's Mixture Model (GMM) to isolate them from the multi-moving item on the complicated background. a unique approach that divides sensory data employing a Gabor filter library with desired orientations and estimates the process of fire. The energy of the wavelengths is also added as an additional aspect to the attribute vector when a temporally-differed image is employed. When all of these traits are added up, a support vector machine (SVM) is produced. to ensure accurate fire detection and better distinguish our data. The suggested fire detection model is validated using multi-conditional video clips. The results of the experiments indicate that the suggested model beats cutting-edge algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on IC curve feature extraction and lithium battery SOH estimation method based on QPSO-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The State of Health (SOH) of lithium-ion power batteries is an important indicator to measure the aging degree of batteries. Accurately predicting SOH is also an important task for vehicle battery management systems. This article is based on three publicly available battery aging cycle test data. First, a smooth Incremental Capacity (IC) curve is drawn by the equal voltage interval method and the five-point cubic filtering method; Secondly, extract the three-dimensional characteristics of the IC curve, reduce the multicollinearity between the eigenvalues through correlation and partial correlation analysis, and analyze the influence of ambient temperature and charge-discharge rate on the eigenvalues; Finally, optimize the input feature vector, and establish a quantum particle swarm optimization BP neural network model (Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization-Back Propagation, QPSO-BP). Compared with the traditional BP model, the error of the evaluation result of this model for SOH does not exceed 2.19%. And it has good generalization ability and prediction accuracy for capacity repair phenomenon, and working conditions with different ambient temperature and charge-discharge rate.

articleTitle: Research on Wordle Development Based on Various Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to predict the distribution of the number of reported results for a given future date in the word solution. In this study, based on the extracted word attributes, the attributes of the words are used as input, and the correlation percentage of (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X) is used as the output, and the Gini coefficient based on the data is established using machine learning. CART decision tree regression and random forest two regression models. Predictions are also made using neural network regression and decision tree regression. Finally, the prediction of the distribution of the number of reported outcomes is done. Then based on the prediction model established in this study, the outcome distribution of the word eerie on March 1, 2023 is predicted. The result demonstrates that the number of attempts of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X accounts for 1%, 8%, 30%, 34%, 19%, 7% and 1%, respectively. In order to classify the difficulty of words, this study first divides words into three categories: hard, medium and easy. Then, based on the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) and Rank-sum ratio (RSR) methods, the difficulty judgment value and classification of each word are obtained respectively. Then, based on Fisher model, multiple logistic regression model and multiple linear regression model, a classification model with word attributes as independent variables was constructed. Then, the RSR logistic regression model with high correct rate is selected for classification by comparing. Finally, the model is used to predict the difficulty of the word eerie, and the result shows that its difficulty is moderate. The results show that the fitting degree of the model is high, and the prediction accuracy meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Comparison and Evaluation of Clustering Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper compared the effects of different clustering models and found some ways to evaluate the cluster models. Clearly, the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and hierarchical clustering model (HAC) were studied. To determine the number of clusters, the Silhouette Coefficients line graph was plotted in model GMM, where the best number of cluster groups was found to be 4. However, the clustering effect is poor, as the scatter diagram shows. Next, a hierarchical clustering model was built, which has a better cluster effect. It is difficult to determine the clustering number in HAC, so the number of clusters in GMM is applied to HAC. It can be seen from the scatter plot that the clustering effect for model HAC is better. In summary, this essay combined the advantages of GMM and HAC, which makes it easier to determine the number of clusters. In addition, this essay used a way to evaluate the clustering models: draw the clusters after dimensionality reduction (PCA) in a 2D scatter plot.

articleTitle: A Framework for Human Action Recognition Using Control Features Fusion and Weighted Entropy Based Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Human behaviour research, human-computer interface, and unavoidable processing all now heavily examine human activity recognition (HAR). Recently, deep learning (DL)-based algorithms have been successfully used to predict various human movements using time-series data from cell phones and wearable sensors. Although DL-based techniques fared exceptionally well at activity detection, they still have trouble handling time series data. Time-series data still has a few problems, such as difficulty in feature extraction, highly unbalanced data, etc. Additionally, the majority of HAR techniques include manual feature orchestration. Bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN) are combined in this article. The proposed multibranch CNN-BiLSTM network performs redid feature extraction from the unprocessed sensor input. The model is prepared for learning area characteristics as well as long-term conditions in successive data thanks to the use of CNN and BiLSTM. In this study, we will fine-tune the weight of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using a novel self-improved Seagull optimisation algorithm (SI-SOA) technique in order to increase the human activity categorization accuracy. The proposed SI-SOA approach will be conceptual amalgamation of the standard Seagull optimization algorithm (SOA).

articleTitle: Wordle Data Exploration and Prediction Based on BP-GA Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Wordle, a fun puzzle game, the acquisition of Wordle by the New York Times led to a surge in the game's popularity. In this article, we aim to explore various data related to Wordle, including the number of daily reported results, words of varying difficulty, and the distribution of user attempts. We use the ARIMA model to predict the number of reported results in the world in the short term, and verify it with the LSTM model, and the results show that our interval prediction is correct. We forecast to reach 14,737 within the forecast range (13,667, 15,807) in the coming months. In addition, we built a BP-GA model to predict the distribution of future reported outcomes and found a number of word attributes, including seven numerical factors and two potential uncertainties that could affect reported outcomes. Based on the random forest model and grid search, the difficulty classification model of words is constructed, and it is found that word frequency and ASCII mean have great influence on the difficulty classification of words. The classification accuracy is 88.89%, which verifies the superiority of the model.

articleTitle: Personalized Federated Learning with Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Privacy concerns have heightened due to the risks associated with data breaches and surveillance, emphasizing the need for personal autonomy and trust in digital interactions. Federated Learning (FL) is a promising solution to this problem as it enables multiple parties to collaborate without disclosing their data. Nevertheless, the presence of non-identically and independently distributed (non-IID) user data can exert adverse effects on the convergence speed and efficacy of training. To address this predicament, this article proposes an evaluation mechanism known as "Genetic evaluation" which endeavors to strike a delicate balance between personalism and globalism while concurrently enhancing client personalism. The " Genetic evaluation " mechanism entails a preliminary genetic search conducted on the parameters derived from stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Subsequently, the deviation between the offspring and the global parameters is computed to quantify their disparities. By judiciously weighing the performance of each offspring and its respective deviation, a specific number of exceptional offspring are identified and selectively preserved in the repository. Finally, this article introduces a novel personalized FL algorithm called FedGA. Empirical evaluations convincingly demonstrate that the proposed algorithm attains superior convergence rates, as evidenced by a remarkable tenfold performance enhancement over FedAvg, a threefold improvement over Per-FedAvg, and a twofold improvement over PFedMe on the widely used CIFAR-10 dataset. Furthermore, experimental results show that FedGA outperforms preceding FedAvg and Per-FedAvg in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Parallel Solution Method for Hamiltonian Equations Based on FPGA and Matlab Programming Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Differential equations play an important role in the fields of artificial intelligence, image processing, and aerospace, and the solution of differential equations is the mathematical basis for research in each field. Traditional numerical methods can approximate the solution of complex differential equations, but there is a problem of accuracy loss in solving systems that do not have asymptotic stability. As a numerical algorithm that preserves the structural properties of Sin, the Sin algorithm has shown advantages in tracking Hamiltonian systems over long periods. However, few studies on the acceleration of the Sim algorithm for Hamiltonian systems do not possess asymptotic stability. To this end, an improved refined Sim algorithm is proposed in this paper and its effectiveness is verified by MATLAB. In addition, an improved fine Sim algorithm IP based on FPGA devices is constructed and its accuracy and parallel acceleration are verified on a hardware platform. This study provides ideas for the research of accelerated computation of the Xin algorithm for Hamiltonian systems without asymptotic stability, which is important for improving the efficiency of numerical solutions.
